520: Kudesha berich hu kare leh legavriel, venatil hahi nishmeta (detzaddik) di beginta, venachta lah lehay gufa detzaddikayya, deityeylid behay alma, veihu itpekad ala venatir lah.
Vei tema, hahu malacha deitmana al ruchehon detzaddikayya, layla shemeh, veat amart deihu gavriel. hachi hu vadday, begin deate missitra dismala, vechol man deate missitra dismala hachi ikre.
Vayyelecha ish: da amram. vayyikkach et bat levi: da yocheved. uvat kol nachtat veamrat leh leizdavvevga bah, deha kariv zimna defurekana deyisrael, al yeda dibbera deityelid minnayyhu.

Vekudesha berich hu siyyea beh, detanenan, shechinta sharya al arsayyhu ureuta dilhon bidvekuta chada, hava bah bishchinta, veal da, la itade shechinta, mehahu bera deolidu lekayyeyma, dichtiv, (Vayikra 11:44) vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim. bar nash dimkaddesh garmeh millera, kudesha berich hu mekaddesh leh leella, kema diruta dillehon hava bidvekuta dishchinta. hachi itdabbeka shechinta, behahu ovada mammash deavdu.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, zakkain innun tzaddikayya diruta dillehon bidvekuta dekudesha berich hu tadir, vechma deinnun mitdabbekin beh tadir, hachi name ihu itdabbak behu, vela shavik lon lealmin. vavy lerashiayyay, diruta dillehon, udevekuta dillehon, mitrachaka minneh. vela day lehu demitrachakan minneh, ella demitdabbekan besitra achara. ta chaze, amram deitdabbak beh bekudesha berich hu. nafak minneh moshe, dekudesha berich hu la ade minneh lealmin, ushechinta itdabbekat bahadeh (Bereshit 21 amud bet) tadir, zakkaa chulakeh.
(Shemot 2:2) vattahar haisha vatteled ben vattere oto ki tov hu. may ki tov hu. amar ribbi chiyyay, deityeylid mahul. begin, deraza divrit, tov ikre, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 3:10) imru tzaddik ki tov.

Ribbi yose amar, nehiru dishchinta denahir beh chamat, divshaata deityelid itmalya kol beta nehora, dichtiv vatter oto ki tov hu, uchetiv (Bereshit 1:4) vayyar elohim et haor ki tov. veal da ki tov hu ketiv, vecholla hava.

Vattitzpenehu shelosha yerachim, 3 yerachim may ka mayyre. amar Rabbi yehuda, remez hu deka ramaz, dela ishtemoda moshe bezihara illaa, ad 3 yerachim. dichtiv, (Shemot 19:1) bachodesh hashelishi, deha keden ityehivat tora al yedoy, ushechinta itgalya, vesharya aloy leenehon decholla, dichtiv, (Shemot 19:3) umoshe ala el haelohim vayyikra elav Adonai. (Shemot 2:3) velo yachla od hatztzefino, dead hahu shata, la ishtemoda milluleh bekudesha berich hu, uchetiv moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaanenu bekol.

Vattikkach lo tevat gome, remez al haaron, deluchot kayyayma alin begavveh, tevat gome, aron habberit ihu. vattachmera vachemar uvazzafet (dehahi teva deihu) deha haaron hava mechuppe millegav umillevar. ribbi yehuda amar, da hi orayyta, dehechomira kudesha berich hu bemitzvot ase uvemitzvot lo taase.

Vattasem bah et hayyeled, ellu yisrael, kema deat amer (Hoshea 11:1) ki naar yisrael vaohavehu. vattasem bassuf dela havo pikkude orayyta chumera lemebad, (Vayikra 286 amud alef) ad sof, dealu yisrael leara, lesof arbein shenin. al sefat hayeor: al memra deinnun demorim orayyta vechukka leyisrael. (nusach acher rabbi chizkiyya ameraz hachi olifna)

Davar acher vayyelech ish, da kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Shemot 15:3) Adonai ish milchama. mibbet levi, da kudesha berich hu, atar dechachma illaa, vehahu nahar, mitchabberan kachada, vela mitparshin lealmin. mibbet levi deashre livyatan (nusach acher kol chedu) lechidu bealma, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:26) livyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo. vayyikkach et bat levi, da kudesha berich hu, atar dinhiru desihara nahir.
Vattahar haishsha vatteled ben. haishsha vadday, kema deat amer (Bereshit 2:23) lezot yikkare ishsha. bekadmita bat levi, vehachi hu vadday, vechi bat levi bekadmita,
521: Vehasheta isha. ella hachi hu vadday, vehachi olifna, itteta ad la izdavvevgat, itkeriat bat peloni, batar deizdavvevgat itkeriat ishsha. vehacha, bat, veishsha, vechalla, chad darga ihu.

(Shemot 2:2) vattitzpenehu (Bereshit 31 amud bet) shelosha yerachim. illen telat yarchin, dedina kashya sharya bealma umay ninhu. tammuz, av, tevet, (nusach acher shevet) may mashma. dead la nachat moshe lealma, shechiach hava ihu leella, veal da izdavvevgat beh shechinta, miyyoma deityelid. mikkan amar ribbi shimon, ruchehon detzaddikayya, (vaychi 202 amud bet) shechichin innun leella, ad la yechotun lealma.

(Shemot 2:3) velo (338 38 174 amud alef) yachla od hatztzefino vegomer. may vattikkach lo tevat gome. dechafat leh besimanaha, lemehve natir meinun nune yamma, deshatin beyamma rabba, dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:25) sham remesho veen mispar. vehi chafat leh, lemehve natir minnayyhu, bechafu (besitra deyovla) (nusach acher dateyset rochla) (nusach acher detayes ravebaylaa) yakkira, ditren gavvnin chivvavr veucham, veanach leh lemoshe benayyhu, deyishtemoda immehon, begin dezamin lesalleka (benayyhu) zimna achara, lekabbela orayyta.
(Shemot 2:Adonai) vattered bat paro lirchotz al hayeor. da ihi deatya missitra dismala dedina kashya, kema deat amar, lirchotz al hayeor, al hayeor dayyka, velo al hayyam.
Vei tema, veha ketiv, (Shemot 17:5) umattecha asher hikkita bo et hayeor, umoshe la macha ella yamma, vekaryeh yeor. ella yeor hava demacha aharon al yede demoshe, veshavyeh kera deihu avid.

Kehay gavvna, (Shemot 7:25) veyimmale shivat yamim achare hakkot Adonai et hayeor. veaharon hikkahu. ella al deata missitra dekudesha berich hu, karyeh kera achare hakkot Adonai, levatar karyeh bishma demoshe. venaaroteha holchot al yad hayeor, illen shear mashshiryayn deatyayn missitra da.

(Shemot 2:6) vattiftach vattirehu et hayyeled. vattirehu vattere mibbae leh. may vattirehu. amar ribbi shimon, let lach milla beorayyta, delet bah razin illain veyakkirin. ella hachi olifna, reshima demalka umatronita ishtechach beh, veihu reshima devav hei. umiyyad vattachmol alav vegomer. ad kan leella, mikkan ulehala letatta, bar mehay kera.

(Shemot 2:4) vattetatztzav achoto merachok vegomer. vattetatztzav achoto, achoto deman. achote, dehahu dekara likkeneset yisrael achoti. kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:2) pitchi li achoti rayati. merachok: kema deat amar (Yirmeyahu 31:3) merachok Adonai nira li.

(May) mashma, deinnun zakkain, ad la nachtu lealma, ishtemodaan innun leella, legabbe kolla, vechol shekken moshe. umashma name, denishmatehon detzaddikayya, itmeshachu meatar illaa, kema deokimna. veraza demilla olifna, demashma, deav vaem it lenishmeta, kema deit av vaem legufa beara, umashma, divkol sitrin, ben leella, ben letatta, midchar venukeba atyayn kolla umishtachche. veha ukemuha raza, dichtiv, totze haaretz nefesh chayya. haaretz: da keneset yisrael. nefesh chayya: (Vayikra 39 amud bet) nafsha deadam kadmaa illaa, kema deittemar. ata ribbi abba uneshakeh. amar vadday shappir kaamart, vehachi hu vadday zakkaa chulakeh demoshe nevia mehemana, al kol shear nevie alma. (ad kan)

(Sitre tora) davar acher vattetatztzav achoto da hi chachma, kema deat amar, (Mishlei 7:4) emor lachachma achoti at. amar ribbi yitzchak, meolam la itadiat (nusach acher ittear) gizrat dina mealma, deha bechol shata dehavu yisrael chatan, hava dina mekatrega immehon, ucheden, vattetatztzav achoto merachok. (davar acher merachok) kema deat amer merachok Adonai nira li. (ad kan)
Vattered bat paro lirchotz al hayeor. beshaata dahavu paske yisrael meorayyta, miyyad vattered bat paro lirchotz al hayeor. havat nachtat middat haddin,
522: Leistachaa middama deyisrael, al elbona deorayyta. venaaroteha holchot al yad hayeor, illen umayya, deinnun azlin veradfin abbatrayyhu, al yad hayeor, al sibbat elbona deorayyta, veinnun demorim (nusach acher demichin) bah, derafu yedayyhu minah.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kol millin dealma, talyayn bitshuva, uvitzlota detzalle bar nash lekudesha berich hu, vechol shekken, man deoshid dimin bitzloteh, delet lach tara, dela alin innun dimin. ma ketiv vattiftach vattirehu et hayyeled. vattiftach, da shechinta, dekayyeyma alayyhu deyisrael, keimma al benin, vehi patcha tadir bizchutehon deyisrael.

Kevan sheppatcha, vattirehu et hayyeled, (Yirmeyahu 31:20) yeled shaashuim. deinnun yisrael, demitchattan kame malchehon (nusach acher maabayhaven) becholla, umiyyad demitchannenan kame kudesha berich hu, hadere bitshuva, uvachan kameh, kivra devache kame avoy, ma ketiv, vehinne naar boche. kevan devache, itadu (sefer acher matetaberay) kol gizrin bishin dealma, ma ketiv vattachmol alav, ittear aloy berachamim, umerachem leh.

Vattomer miyyalde haivrim ze, deinnun rakke libba, vela miyyalde haavodat kochavim umazzalot, deinnun keshe kedal, ukeshe libba. miyyalde haivrim rakke libba meavahan umeimmahan leatava kame marehon. vattikra et em hayyaled. shehayta bocha, hada hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:15) kol berama nishma nehi (8 amud alef) bechi tamrurim rachel mevakka al baneha vegomer, hu boche veem hayyeled hi bocha.

Amar ribbi yehuda, lezimna deate ma ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:9) bivchi yavou uvetachanunim vegomer. mahu bivchi yavou. bizchut bechi deem hayyeled, shehi rachel, yavou veyitkanshun min galuta. veamar ribbi yitzchak, purekana deyisrael la talya ella bivchi, kad yishtallemun veyichlun, bechi demaot devacha esav kame aviv, dichtiv, (Bereshit 27:38) veyissa esav kolo vayyevch. (amar rabbi yose oto bechi devacha asu) veinnun dimin, achitu leyisrael begaluteh. kevan deyichlun innun dimin bevichya deyisrael, yifkun miggaluteh, hada hu (Yirmeyahu 31:9) dichtiv bivchi yavou uvetachanunim ovilem.

(Shemot 2:12) vayyifen ko vacho. chama beillen 50 atvavn, dimyachadin leh yisrael bechol yoma, shema yisrael paamayim, deit behon 25 25 tere zimne, vela chama beh. vayyifen ko vacho vegomer. ko vacho, amar ribbi abba, ko chama, i havo beh ovadin dechashran. vacho i zamin lenafka minneh bera mealya, miyyad vayyar ki en ish. chama beruach kudesha, dela zamin lenafka minneh bera mealya.

Deamar ribbi abba, kamma chayyayvin innun bealma, demafke beni mealya, yattir meinun zakkain. vehahu bera mealya denafak min chayyayva, ihu mealya yattir, lemeheve tahor mittame. nehora miggo chashocha. chachmeta miggo tippeshuta. veda ihu mealya mikkolla.

Vayyar. vyyar dehacha, kolla beruach kudesha istachal vechama, uvegin kach istakkal beh vekatal leh, vekudesha berich hu sivev kolla, limhach lehahu bera, kema deazal yaakov legabbe hahu bera, dichtiv, (Shemot 2:15) vayyeshev al habbeer. beyaakov ketiv, (Bereshit 29:2) vayyar vehinne beer. bemoshe ketiv, vayyeshev beeretz midyan vayyeshev al habbeer. begin demoshe veyaakov, af al gav divdarga chada havo, istalak moshe behay yattir minneh.

Ribbi yose veribbi yitzchak havo azle beorcha. amar ribbi yose, hahu beer dechama yaakov, vechama moshe, i da hava hahu bera, dechafar avraham veyitzchak. amar leh lav. ella, beshaata deitbere alma, itbere hay bera. uveerev shabbat ben hashshemashot, itbere puma dileh, vehay ihu beer dechamu yaakov umoshe.
Matnitin. innun derodfe keshot, innun detave raza dimhemanuta. innun deitdevaku bekishshura mehemana. innun deyadin orchoy demalka illaa. kerivu shimu.

Kad seliku teren, venafku lekadmut chad, mekabbelin leh ben teren deroin. teren nachte litlata (nusach acher letatta) teren innun, chad minayyhu chakla detappuchin kaddishin ihu mehay bera yatve (teren yatve) motva dinvie (sefer acher benoy) yankin behu. chad benayyhu, chibbura ihu decholla, ihu natil mikkolla
523: Hahu bera kaddisha, kaim techotayyhu, chakla detappuchin kaddishin ihu mehay bera itshakyayn adarayyay, derae moshe bemadbera, mehai bera itshakyayn adariyay debarir yaakov kad barir lon lego chulake kol innun retichin, kol innun mare degadpin. telat kayymin reviin al hay bera. hay bera minnayyhu itmele. adonay itkere, al da ketiv, (Devarim 3:24) adonay Adonai atta hachillota vegomer. uchetiv (Daniel 9:17) vehaer panecha al mikdashcha hashshamem lemaan adonay, adon kol haaretz, hada hu dichtiv, (Yehoshua 3:11) hinne aron habberit adon kol haaretz. beh ganiz chad mekora kaddisha, dinvia beh tadir, veamle leh, Adonai tzevaot ikre. berich hu lealam ulealme almin. (ad kan)

Ulechohen midyan sheva banot vattavona vattidlena vegomer. amar ribbi yehuda, i bera da, ihu bera deyaakov, ha ketiv beh, (Bereshit 29:3) veneesfu shamma chol haadarim vegalalu vegomer. vehacha benot yitro la itzterichu lehay. ella vattavona vattidlena belo torach achara.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, yaakov ade lah min bera, deha ketiv, kad mitkanshe tamman kol adarayay, veheshivu et haeven. uveyaakov, la ketiv vayyashev et haeven, deha la itzterich levatar ken, deha bekadmita mayya la havo sallekin, kevan deata yaakov, seliku mayya legabbeh, (umoshe uf hachi seliku mayya legabbeh) vehahu avna, la hava al pum bera, uvegin kach vattavona vattidlena.
Rabbi elazar 206 abba havo azle mitteverya letzippori. ad dahavu azle, paga behu chad yuday, itchabbar bahadayyhu, amar ribbi elazar, kol chad lema milla deorayyta.

Patach ihu veamar, (Yechezkel 37:4) vayyomer elay hinnave ben adam hinnave el haruach veamarta el haruach vegomer. mehay kera yedana, atar deharuach nafka minneh, vechi yachil hava yechezkel lenabbea al haruach, veha ketiv (Kohelet 8:8) en adam shallit baruach lichlo et haruach. ella, bar nash la yachil leshalletaa baruach, aval kudesha berich hu ihu shallit becholla, veal memreh hava mitnabbe yechezkel. vetu deha ruach hava begufa behay alma, uvegin kach itnabbe aleh, (Bereshit 130, amud alef bammidrash hannelam) mearba ruchot boi haruach, mehahu atar deittecham besamchoy bearba sitrin dealma.

Dalig hahu yudai kameh, amar leh ribbi elazar, may chamit. amar milla chamena. amar leh may hi. amar leh ruach bene adam, i itlavash began eden bilvusha dediyyukena begufa dehay alma, hava leh lemichtav, ko amar Adonai miggan eden boi haruach, mahu mearba ruchot.

Amar leh, rucha la nachta lehay alma, ad desalleka migginta deara, lego kuresyay, dekayyeyma (Shemot 15 amud bet) al arba samchin. kevan desalleka tamman, istaava miggo hahu kuresyay demalka, venachta lehay alma, gufa itnetil mearba sitre alma, ruach uf hachi itnetil mearba sitre dechuresyyay, demittatkena alayyhu.

Amar leh hahu bar nash, deliga deka daligna kamayychu, milla chamena mehay sitra. begin deyoma chada havena azil bemadbera, vachamena ilana chad demirgag lemechoze, vechad mearta techoteh, karivna gabbeh vachamena hahi mearta, desalleka rechin mikkol zine rechin dealma. ittakafna begarmay veailna behahi mearta, venachitna bedargin yedian bego ducheta chada, dehavu beh illanin saggiin verechin uvusemin, dela yachilna lemisbal.

Vetamman chamena chad bar nash, vesharvita chad bideh. vahava kaim bechad pitcha, kevan dechama li, tava vekam legabbay. amar li, ma at hacha, umean at, ana dachilna sagya, amena leh, mari, min chavrayyay ana, kach vechach chamena bemadbera, vealana behay mearta, venachitna hacha.
Amar li, hoil umin chavrayyay ant, tol hay kitra dichtava, vehav leh lechavrayyay, innun deyadin razin deruchehon detzaddikayya
524: Vatash bi behahu sharvita, vedamichna. addehachi, chamena kamma chelin umashshiryayn go shenata, dahavo atyayn beorcha, lehahu ducheta. vehahu gavra batash behahu sharvita, veamar beorcha deilani zilu. addehachi dahavo azli, parche baavira vesalke, vela yedana lean atar. ushemana kalin demashshiryayn saggiin, vela yedana mean (sefer acher lean atar) ihu. ittearna, vela chamena midi, vedachilna behahu atar.

Addehachi, chamena lehahu bar nash, amar li, chamit midi, amena leh, chamena go shenata kach vechach. amar, behahu archa azle ruchehon detzaddikayya, go ginta deeden leaala tamman. uma deshamat minnayyhu, hu, dekayyme beginta bediyyukena dehay alma vechaddan beruchehon detzaddikayya dealin tamman.

Uchema degufa itbeni behay alma, mikketura dearba yesode, veittzayayr behay alma. uf hachi rucha, ittzayayr beginta, mikketura dearba ruchin dekayyeyma beginta, vehahu rucha, itlabbesha tamman, umittzayrat minnayyhu, betziyyura dediyyukena degufa, deittzayyayr behay alma. veilmale innun arba ruchin, deinnun avirin deginta, rucha la mittzayyeyra betziyyura kelal, vela itlabbesha behu.

Innun 4 ruchin, ketirin illen beillen kachada, vehahu ruach ittzayyayr veitlavash behu, kegavvna degufa ittzayayr bekitture, ded yesode alma. uvegin kach, mearba ruchot boi haruach, meinun arba ruchin degan eden, deitlavsha veittzeyret behu, vehashsheta tol hay kitra dichtava vezil learchach, vehav leh lechavrayyay.

Ata ribbi elazar, veinnun chavrayyay, venshakuhu beresheh, amar ribbi elazar, berich rachamana, deshadrach hacha, devadday da hu berira demilla, vekudesha berich hu azmin lefumi hay kera. yehav lon hahu kitra dichtava, kevan denatal leh ribbi elazar, ufatach leh, nafak afuta deeshsha, veaschar leh, chama beh ma dechama, ufarach min yedoy.

Bacha Rabbi elazar, veamar man yachil lekayyeyma beginzayyay demalka, (Tehillim 15:1) Adonai mi yagur beoholecha mi yishkon behar kadshecha. zakkaa hay orcha, vehahi shaata deirana bach. umehahu yoma hava chadde ribbi elazar, velo amar kelum lechavrayyay, ad dahavo azle, pagu bechad bera demayya, kayymu aleh, veshatu min mayya.

Amar ribbi elazar, zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayya, yaakov arak mikkame achuy, veizdeman leh bera, kevan devira chama leh, mayya ishtemodau lemarehon, vesallekin legabbeh, vechaddu bahadeh, vetamman izdavvevgat leh bat zugeh. moshe arak mikkame paro, veizdaman leh hahu bera, umayin chamu leh, veishtemodau lemarehon, vesalku legabbeh, vetamman izdavvevgat leh bat zugeh.

Ma ben moshe leyaakov, yaakov ketiv beh, (Bereshit 29:10) vayhi kaasher raa yaakov et rachel vegomer. vayyiggash yaakov vayyagel et haeven vegomer. moshe ma ketiv beh, vayyavou haroim vay gorashum vayyakam moshe vayyoshian vegomer. bevadday yada hava moshe, kevan dechama mayya desallekin legabbeh, detamman tizdaman leh bat zugeh. vetu, deha ruach kudesha, la itade minneh lealmin uveh hava yada, detzippora teheve bat zugeh. amar moshe, vadday yaakov ata lehacha, umayya seliku legabbeh, izdaman leh bar nash deachnish leh leveteh, veyahav leh kol ma deitztarich. ana uf hachi.

Amar hahu bar nash, hachi olifna, deyitro komer lekochavim umazzalot hava. kevan dechama dekochavim umazzalot let bah mammashu. itperash mippulechana dile. kamu amma venidduhu. kevan dechamu benateh, havo metarchan lon, deha bekadmita innun havo raan aneh. kevan dechama moshe beruach kudesha, deal milla dekochavim umazzalot havo avde, miyyad vayyakam moshe vayyoshian vayyashk et tzonam. veitavid kina lekudesha berich hu becholla.
Amar leh ribbi elazar, ant legabban, vela yedana
525: Shemecha. amar, ana yoezri ben yaakov. atu chavrayyay uneshakuhu, amru, uma ant legabban, vela havinan yadin bach. azlu kachada kol hahu yoma leyoma achara ozfuhu telat milin, veazil leorcheh.

(Shemot 2:19) vattomarna ish mitzri hitztzilanu. ribbi chiyyay amar, ha ukemuha chavrayyay, denitznetza behu ruach kudesha, veamru, velo yadu ma amru. levar nash, dehava yativ bemadbera, vahavu yomin dela achal bisra. yoma chad ata dova lenatla chad imra, arak imra, vedova avatreh, ad dematu legabbe hahu bar nash lemadbera, chama imra, veatkif beh ushechateh veachal bisra.

Davar acher (Shemot 1:1) veelle shemot bene yisrael. ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 1:Adonai) shechora ani venava vegomer, shechora ani venava, da keneset yisrael, dehi shechora min galuta, venava, dehi nava beorayyta, uvefikkudin, uveovadin dechashran. benot yerushala 40, deal da, zakkain leyartaa yerushalam dilella. keohole kedar, af al gav dehi koderet begaluta, beovadin hi kiriot shelomo, kiriot, demalka dishlama kolla dileh.

Ribbi chiyyay rabba, hava azil legabbe marehon dematnita, lemelaf minayyhu. azal legabbe ribbi shimon ben yochay, vechama pargod chad, dehava pasik beveta. tava ribbi chiyyay, amar, eshma milla mippumeh mehacha.

Shama dehava amar, (Shir HaShirim 8:14) berach dodi udeme lecha litzvi o leofer haayyalim. kol kissufa dichsifu yisrael mikudesha berich hu, deamar rabbi shimon, taavatam shel yisrael, sheyyihye hakadosh baruch hu lo holech velo mitrachek, ella boreach katztzevi o keofer haayyalim.

May tama, amar rabbi shimon, en chayya baolam osa kemo hatztzevi o keofer haayyalim, bizman shehu boreach holech meat meat, umachazir et rosho lemakom sheyyatza mimmennu, uleolam tamid hu machazir et rosho laachorav. kach amru yisrael, ribbono shel olam, im anu gormim shettistallek mibbenenu, yehi ratzon, shettivrach kemo hatztzevi o kemo ofer haayyalim, shehu boreach umachazir et rosho lemmakom shehinniach, hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 26:44) veaf gam zot bihyotam beeretz oyvehem lo meastim velo gealtim lechallotam. davar acher, hatztzevi keshehu yashen, hu yashen beayin achat, vehaacheret hu neor, kach amru yisrael lekudesha berich hu, ase kemo hatztzevi, shehinne lo yanum velo yishan shomer yisrael.

Shama ribbi chiyyay veamar, i illain (paskin) askin beveta, vaana yativ avray, bacha. shama rabbi shimon veamar, vadday shechinta levara, man yippuk. amar ribbi elazar bereh. i ana kalena, (kachevalea) la kalena deha shechinta bara minnana, leul shechinta, veteheve eshshata shelemata. shama kala deamar, ad la samchin istemachu, vetarin la ittakanu, umizutere (nusach acher vametavetarey) devusemayya deeden dichan hu, la nafak Rabbi elazar.

Yativ ribbi chiyyay, bacha veitgannach, patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 2:17) sov deme lecha dodi litzvi o leofer haayyalim. itpetach tara defargoda, la ayiyil ribbi chiyyay, zakif ribbi shimon enoy veamar, shema minnah ityehayv reshuta leman deihu avray vaanan lego. kam ribbi shimon, azal essa midducheteh, ad ducheta deribbi chiyyay, amar ribbi shimon, kuzetifa dinhora dekalitra (sefer acher dakeladeytea) levar, vaana hacha lego, itallam pumeh deribbi chiyyay.

Kevan deal lego, maich enoy, vela zakif resheh. amar ribbi shimon leribbi elazar bereh, kum avar yadach afumeh, dela yada behay, dela ragil beh. kam ribbi elazar, abar yedeh afumeh deribbi chiyyay, patach pumeh ribbi chiyyay, veamar, chama ena ma dela chamena, izdekaf dela chashivna, tav lememat beeshsha dedahava tava dalik.
Beatar dishvivin zarkin lechol ivar, vechol sheviva usheviva, salik litlat mea
526: Veshivin retichin. vechol reticha, itperash leelef alfin, veribbo rivvavn, ad dematu leattik yomin, deyativ al kurseyay, vechurseyay mizdazea minneh, lematan veshittin almin.

Ad demata laatar idduna detzaddikayyay, ad deishtema bechol rekiin, vechol illain vetattain, vechullehu bezimna chada, tavvhin veamrin, haden hu ribbi shimon ben yochay, dehava marish kolla, man yachil lemekam kameh. den hu ribbi shimon ben yochay, divshaata defatach pumeh lemishre lemile beorayyta, tzayytin lekalleh, kol kursevavn vechol rekiin vechol retichin, vechol innun dimshabbeche lemarehon.

Let defatchin velet dimsayyeymin, kullehu mishtakkechin, ad la ishtema (nusach acher daleshatemaa) bechol rekiayya dilella vetatta, pitra. kad mesayyem ribbi shimon lemile beorayyta, man chame shirin, man chame chedvata, dimshabbechin lemarehon, man chame kalin deazlin bechullehu rekiin. atyayn kullehu begineh derabbi shimon, vecharin vesagdin kame demarehon, sallekin rechin devusemin deeden, ad attik yomin, vechol hay begineh derabbi shimon.

Patach ribbi shimon pumeh veamar, shit dargin nachtu immeh deyaakov lemitzrayim vechol chad vechad asara elef ribbo. velokovlehon shit dargin leyisrael. velokovlehon (206 amud alef) shit dargin lechurseyay dilella. velokovlehon shit dargin lechurseyay diltatta. dichtiv, (Melachim 1 10:19) shesh maalot lakkisse. hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 16:7) revava ketzemach hassade netattich vegomer, hare shit. velokovlehon ketiv, uvene yisrael paru vayyishretzu vayyirbu vayyaatzmu vegomer.
Ta chaze, kol chad vechad salik laasara, vahavu shittin, veinnun shittin gavrin divsacharane shechinta, veinnun shittin ribbevan, denafku im yisrael miggaluta, udealu im yaakov begaluta.

Amar leh Rabbi chiyyay, veha havo (sefer acher chamenan) shiva, vesallekin leshivin, amar leh Rabbi shimon, shivin lav mehacha, vei salleka datach shiva, ha ketiv (Shemot 25:32) veshishsha kanim yotzim mitztziddeha shelosha kene menora vegomer. vekane haechad haemtzai lav bechushbana, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 8:2) el mul peni hammenora yairu vegomer.

Ad dahavo yatve, amar ribbi elazar leribbi shimon avuy, me chama kudesha berich hu, lenachta yisrael, lemitzrayim begaluta. amar leh chada sheelta at shail, o teren. amar leh teren. galuta lamma. ulemitzrayim lemma. amar leh teren innun veitchazzeru lechad. amar leh kum bekiyyumach beginach yitkeyaym leella, mishshemach hay milla, ema beri ema.

Patach veamar (Shir HaShirim 6:8) shishshim hemma melachot ushemonim pilagshim. shishshim hemma melachot, innun gavrayya dilella mechela digvura deitachadan bekalifin (nusach acher bagelaypayn), dechevata kaddisha deyisrael. ushemonim pilagshim, memanan biglifoy ditchotoy. vaalamot en mispar, kema deat amer (Iyov 25:3) hayesh mispar ligdudav. veim kol da ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 6:9) achat hi yonati tamati achat hi leimmah, da hi shechinta kaddisha denafka matrisin (nusach acher materaysar) zihara, dezihara denahir lecholla, veihi itkere ima.

Kegavvna da avid kudesha berich hu beara, zarik lechol ammin lechol ivar, umane alehen ravreve, hada hu dichtiv (Devarim 4:19) asher chalak Adonai elohecha otam lechol haammim, vehu nasiv lechulakeh kenishta deyisrael, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato. vekara lah achat hi yonati tammati achat hi leimmah, da hi shechinat yekareh, deashre benehon, achat hi umeyuchedet leh. rauha vanot vayashsheruha, kema deat amer (Mishlei 31:29) rabbot banot aso chayil veat alit al kullana. melachot ufilagshim vayhalleluha, illen ravreve ammin deitpakdan alayyhu.

Veod raza demilla hi dittenan baasara maamarot nivra haolam, vechad tistakkal telata innun, vealma behu itberi, (Shemot 31:3) bechachma uvitvuna uvedaat, vealma la itbere ella beginehon deyisrael, kad baa lekayyeyma alma, aved leavraham beraza dechachma. leyitzchak, beraza ditvuna. leyaakov beraza dedaat. uvehay itkere, (Mishlei 24:4) uvedaat chadarim yimmalu. uvehahi shaata ishtachllal kol alma. umiddeityelidu
527: Leyaakov teresar shevatin, ishtachllal kolla, kegavvna dilella.

Kad chama kudesha berich hu chedavavta saggia dehay alma tattaa, deishtachllal kegavvna dilella, amar, dilma chas veshalom yitarvun bishar amamin, veyishtear pegimuta bechullehu almin. ma aved kudesha berich hu, tiltel lechullehu mehacha lehacha, ad denachtu lemitzrayim, lemedar diyyurehon beam keshe kedal, dimvazzin nimmusehon, umevazzin lehon leitchattena behu, uleitarva bahadayyhu, vachashivu lehon avdin. guverin gaalan behon, nukevta gaalan behon ad deishtachllal kolla vezara kaddisha, uven kach uven kach shelim chova dishar ammin, dichtiv, (Bereshit 15:16) ki lo shalem avon haemori ad henna. vechad nafku, nafku zakkain kaddishin, dichtiv, (Tehillim 122:4) shivte yah edut leyisrael. ata Rabbi shimon uneshakeh berisheh, amar leh kaim beri bekiyyumach, deshata kayyeyma lach.

Yativ Rabbi shimon, ver elazar bereh kaim umefaresh mille deraze dechachmeta, vahavu anpoy nehirin keshimsha. umillin mitbadderin vetasin birkia. yatvu teren yomin dela achlu velo shatu, vela havo yadin i hava yemama o lelya. kad nafku, yadu dahavo teren yomin dela taamu midi. kara al da ribbi shimon, (Shemot 34:28) vayhi sham im Adonai arbaim yom vearbaim layla lechem lo achal vegomer. uma i anan beshaata chada kach, moshe, dikra ashid beh, vayhi sham im Adonai arbaim yom vegomer, al achat kamma vechamma.

Kad ata ribbi chiyyay kameh deribbi, vesach leh ovada, tava ribbi, veamar leh Rabbi shimon ben gamliel avoy, beri, Rabbi shimon ben yochay arya, veribbi elazar bereh arya, velav Rabbi shimon kishar aryevavta, aleh ketiv (Amos 3:8) arye shaag mi lo yira vegomer. uma almin dilella mizdazein minneh, anan al achat kamma vechamma. gavra dela gazar taanita lealmin al ma deshail uvae, ella hu gozer, kudesha berich hu mekayyem. kudesha berich hu gozer, veihu mevattel. vehayeynu ditnan, may dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 23:3) moshel baadam tzaddik moshel yirat elohim, hakadosh baruch hu moshel baadam, umi moshel vohakadosh baruch hu, tzaddik. deihu gozer gezera, vehatztzaddik mevattelah.
Tenan, amar Rabbi yehuda, en lach davar bachavivuta kame kudesha berich hu, kemo tefillatan shel tzaddikim, veaf al gav denicha leh, zimnin deavid bautehon, zimnin dela avid.

Tanu rabbanan, zimna chada hava alma tzericha lemitra, ata ribbi eliezer, vegazar arbein taanita, vela ata mitra, tzalle tzelota, vela ata mitra. ata ribbi akiva, vekam vetzalle, amar mashshiv haruach, venashav zika, amar umorid haggeshem, veata mitra. chalash dateh deribbi eliezri, istakkol ribbi akiva beanpoy.

Kam ribbi akiva kame amma veamar, emshol lachem mashal, lema haddavar dome, ribbi eliezri dame lirchima demalka, derachim leh yattir, vechad al kame malka, nicha leh, vela bae lemaytan leh bauteh bivhilu, ki hechi dela litperash minneh, denicha leh delishtee bahadeh. vaana dame leavda demalka, devaa bauteh kameh, vela bae malka deleul letare palterin, vekol shekken delishtee bahadeh, amar malka, havu leh bauteh bivhilu, vela leul hacha. kach ribbi eliezri ihu rechima demalka, vaana avda, uvae malka leishtee bahadeh kol yoma, vela yitperish minneh. vaana, la bae malka deiul tare defalterin. nach dateh deribbi eliezri.

Amar leh, akiva, ta veema lach milleta, deitchazya li bechelma hay pesuka, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 7:16) veatta al titpallel bead haam hazze veal tissa vaadam rinna utefilla veal tifga bi. ta chaze, teresar ture afarsemona (dachya) al hahu delavish choshna veefoda, uvaa min kudesha berich hu, lemechas al alma vead haidana tale ihu. i hachi amay chalash dateh deribbi eliezri. mishshum bene nasha, dela yadin behay.
Amar ribbi eliezer tamne sare ture afarsemona (dachya) illain, alin nishmatehon detzaddikayya, vearbein vetisha rechin, sallekin
528: Bechol yoma, ad hahu atar deitkere eden, di lekavel da, ityehivat orayyta, bemt panim tame, uvemt panim tahor. 49 atvavn bishmahn dishvati. 49 yomin lekabbela orayyta. 49 yomin kaddishin illain kayymin, lemital reshuta bechol yoma meavanin zehirin, diglefan behahu choshna.

Vehahu delavish choshna, yativ bechurseyay kaddisha yakkira, (Shemot 13 amud alef) dearba samchin kayymin mistakkelin bechoshna, al memrih alin, veal memreh nafkin, zakfan aynin umistakkelin leella, chaman tzitza, delahit beshit mea veesrin ivar, ushema kaddisha illaa, galif aloy, mizdazean umitchalchelan. ketire besitroy dimina kaddisha, dismala natil bidoy samche shemayya, alil lon, vegalle lon. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 34:4) venagollu chassefer hashshamayim.

Amar le rabbi akiva mahu dichtiv (Shir HaShirim 6:11) el ginat egoz yaradti. amar le ta chaze, hahu ginta nafka meeden, veda hi shechinta. egoz: da hi reticha illaa kaddisha, deinun arba reshin denaharin, demitparshan min ginta, kehay egoza, deinun arba reshin kadishin lego. umay deamar yaradti, kema ditnan, yarad peloni lamerkava.

Amar leh Rabbi akiva, i hachi, hava leh lememar, laegoz yaradti, mahu el ginnat egoz yaradti. amar leh, mishshum dehi shevacha deegoza. ma egoza, temira usetima mikkol sitroy, kach reticha denafka migginta, setima mikkol sitroy. ma innun arba kerishin di beegoza, mitchabberan behay gisa, umitparshan mehay gisa. kach reticha, mitchabberan beachaduta bechedvavta bishlemuta, umitperash kol chad beivroy, al ma deitmane hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:13) hu hassovev et kol eretz hachavila hu haholech kidmat ashshur, vechen kullam.
Amar ribbi akiva, hay lichlucha dehi biklippoy deegoza, lemay remiza. amar leh, af al gav deorayyta la galle leh, behay galle.

Ta chaze, (sefer acher shekedim), minnehon meriran, uminhon metikan, uremiza it lon, it mare dedina kashya, veit mare desheruta, aval kol remiza degalle beorayyta chazinan dedina havi, vehachi hu leyirmiyyahu, achzu leh bedina, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 1:11) makkel shaked ani roe. may shaked. shekedim mammash. vechen bematte aharon, (Bamidbar 17:23) vayyigmol shekedim. umin tevuta mammash, ishtema, dehu dina kashya. dichtiv, (Daniel 9:14) vayyshkod Adonai al haraa. vechen (Yirmeyahu 1:12) shoked ani al devari, vechen kullam. amar leh Rabbi akiva, mashma kol ma deavad kudesha berich hu, lemelaf mineh chachmeta saggia, dichtiv, (Mishlei 16:4) kol paal Adonai lamaanehu. Rabbi elazar amar mehacha, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:31) vayyar elohim et kol asher asa vehinne tov meod. mahu meod. lemelaf minneh chachmeta illaa.

Amar ribbi yehuda, may dichtiv, (Kohelet 7:14) gam et ze leummat ze asa haelohim. kegavvna dirkia, aved kudesha berich hu beara, vechullehu remiza lema dilella. dechad hava chame Rabbi abba, chad ilana, deiveh itavid ofa defarach minneh, hava bache veamar, i havo bene nasha yade lemay remizan, havo mevazan malbushehon ad tabburehon, lemay deitneshe chachma minnehon. kol shekken bishar ma deavad kudesha berich hu beara.

Kidamar Rabbi yose, illanin, innun deitchaze minnehon chachmeta, kegon charuva, dekal, pistuka, vechaddome lon, kullehu bechad rechiva (rateybea) itrechavu. kol innun deavdin perin, bar mittappuchin, raza chada innun, bar shevilin deitparshan.

Kol innun dela avdin perin, veinnun ravrevin, bar mearvin denachala, deit lehu raza bilchodoy kegavvna dilella, mechad yenika yeniku, vechol chad meinun deinhu zutere, bar meezova, meima chada ityelidu.

Kol asavin deara, deitmene alehon ravrevin takkifin bishmayya. kol chad vechad raza bilchodoy, kegavvna dilella, uvegin kach ketiv, (Vayikra 19:19) sadcha lo tizra kilayim. dechol chad vechad al bilchodoy, venafik bilchodoy, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 38:33) hayadata chukkot shamayim im tasim mishtaro baaretz. uchetiv
529: (Yeshayahu 40:26) lechullam beshem yikra. uma bechol ma divalma raza bilchodoy vela baa kudesha berich hu legallaa lon, ulearveva lon, ukeran bishmahan. bene yaakov deinnun shevatin kaddishin, deinnun kiyyuma dealma, al achat kamma vechamma, hada hu dichtiv veelle shemot bene yisrael.
Rabbi yose bar yehuda amar, ilu neemar elle shemot, mashma dehachi hu. hasheta dichtiv veelle shemot, mashma deal harishonim mosif, ma harishonim bene yaakov, af kan bene yaakov.

Amar ribbi yehuda, chas veshalom, beshaata deamar kudesha berich hu, (Bereshit 46:4) anochi ered immecha mitzrayma, salleka datach dishchinta techot immeh behahi shaata (amar leh veha ketiv anochi ered immach mitzrayma, immach) mammash, ella, beshaata dahavat yerida livnohi, nachtat shechinta, hada hu dichtiv, anochi ered immecha mitzrayma, veanochi aalcha gam alo, kol zimna dihave lach aliyyay, kivyachol aliyyay it li, uveshaata dihave lach yerida, kivyachol anochi ered immecha. vead demit yosef vechol achuy, vahavat lon yerida, kamat shechinta venachtat immehon, kema denachtu illen, kach nachtu illen.

Amar (sefer acher Rabbi yose 202 30) Rabbi yehuda ma ketiv leel minneh, (Bereshit 50:26) vayyamat yosef ben mea vaesher shanim vegomer, behahi shaata demit yosef, vechullehu shevatin, vahava lon yerida, nachtu bene yisrael begaluta, ushechinta umalache illae nachtu immehon, hada hu dichtiv, veelle shemot beni yisrael, deinnun ittosafu al kadmae lemechat begaluta.

Amar leh, i hachi, yaakov hava mit o la. amar leh mit. amar leh, umahu dichtiv habbaim mitzrayma et yaakov, i bechayye, ema et yaakov, vei batar demit, appik mittamman et yaakov. ella ta chaze, la amar kera hayyordim mitzrayma et yaakov, dead kean la havat yerida leyaakov, ella habbaim, olifna deatu immeh deyaakov, veazlu lehon, ad denachtu illen begaluta, nachtu illen immehon, hada hu dichtiv veelle shemot vegomer.

Rabbi dostay amar, bechol yoma veyoma havo atyayn, veazlin lon, hada hu dichtiv habbaim mitzrayma, vela ketiv asher bau, vehayeynu dichtiv habbaim mitzrayma bekadmita et yaakov. ulevatar kad havat lon yerida ish uveto bau. veta chaze, bene yaakov kullehu havo metin behahu zimna venachtu illen veillen.

Ribbi yose veribbi elazar amru, hay parsheta millin illain it bah, ditnan, beshaata denachtu illen retichin umashshiryayn kaddishin, dioknehon dishvatin, diglifin leella, kullehu alan lemedar immehon. hada hu dichtiv, ish uveto bau, uchetiv reuven shimon levi.
Davar acher veelle shemot bene yisrael habbaim mitzrayma et yaakov vegomer. itchazar parsheta da, lema deamar ribbi yose beribbi yehuda, vecholla hava.

Veta chaze, ribbi elazar ben arach, kad hava mate lehay fasuk, hava bache, detanya, amar ribbi elazar ben arach, beshaata deazlu yisrael begaluta, itkenashu kullehu nishmatehon dishvatin, limarta dechafelta, tzavvchu veamru: sava sava, keeva divnin lav ballauta (begaluta) dealma den, banycha kullehu mishtabedin bekashyu, am acharan avdin behu nukemin dealma.

Behahi shaata, ittear rucheh dehahu sava, reshuta shail, venachit, kara kudesha berich hu lechol retichoy umashshiryayteh, umalchehon berashehon. venachtu kullehu im yaakov veim shivtohi. shevatin nachtu chayyin im avuhon, ushevatin nachtu metim im avuhon, hada hu dichtiv veelle shemot bene yisrael habbaim mitzrayma vegomer uchetiv reuven shimon levi vegomer. veta chaze, metim havo, venachtu, uchetiv veyosef haya vemitzrayim. amar ribbi abba, behay itkere (Tehillim 103:13) kerachem av al banim.

Rabbi yehuda bar shalo 40 hava azil beorcha verabbi abba hava ime alu lechad atra uvatu taman. achlu kad bau lemishkav shavu reshehon behahu tila deara dehava chad kivra taman ad la demichu kara chad kala min kivra amar zara leara azla. teresar shenin hava
530: Dela itarit bar haidana departzufa debri chamina hacha.

Amar ribbi yehuda, man at. amar leh yuday ana, vaana yativ nezifa, daana la yachilna lemeal, begin hahu tzaara divri, deganveh hahu avodat kochavim umazzalot, kad ihu hava zeera, vealke leh kol yoma, vetzaara dileh dache li lemeal beduchetay, uvehay atra la ittearit, bar haiddana.

Amar leh veattun yadin betzaara dechayye. amar leh, sare kivri, i lav bauta dilan al chayye, la yitkayyeymun palgut yoma (nusach acher bealma), vehaiddana itarit hacha, dahavo amrin li kol yoma, dilaagala yeti beri hacha, vela yadana i bechayye i bemota.

Amar leh ribbi yehuda, may avidtayychu behahu alma. itregish kivra, veamar, azilu kumu, dehaiddana yilkun livri, tavvhu, vearku mittamman kefalgut mil, yatvu ad denahir tzafra. kamu lemezal, chamu chad bar nash, dehava rahit vearak, vahava shatit dama achatfoy, achdu beh, vesach leho ovada, amru leh ma shemecha. amar lehu, lachma bar levae. amru, uma (bar) levae bar lachma hava hahu meta, umistafena leishtauye yattir bahadeh. la ahadru. amar ribbi abba, hay deamru, ditzlothon demetayyay, meginan al chayye. menalan. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 13:22) vayyaalu vannegev vayyavo ad chevron.

Amar ribbi yehuda, ta chaze, teren nedarin nadar kudesha berich hu leyaakov. chad, deyechut immeh lemedar immeh begaluta, vechad deyyeskineh mikkivrih, lemecheme chedvavta desiyyayta kaddisha dedayyre im benohi, hada hu dichtiv, anochi ered immecha mitzrayma anochi ered immecha begaluta. veanochi aalcha gam alo, kema deat amer (Yechezkel 37:12) vehaaleti etchem mikkivrotechem ammi. uchetiv (Tehillim 122:4) sheshsham alu shevatim vegomer.

Davar acher (Shemot 1:8) vayyakam melech chadash al mitzrayim vegomer, amar rabbi shimon, behahu yoma, ityehiv leh reshuta lesaro shel mitzrayim, al kol shear ammin, detana, ad dela mit yosef, la ityehiv shultanu leshultana demitzrayim al yisrael, kevan demit yosef, keden vayyakam melech chadash al mitzrayim, vayyakam: keman dehava maich vekam.

(Vayyakam melech chodesh vechulei) ribbi yitzchak patach, (Shir HaShirim 1:12) ad shehammelech bimsibbo nirdi natan recho. ad shehammelech: da kudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 44:6) ko amar Adonai melech yisrael. uchetiv (Devarim 33:5) vayhi vishurun melech. bimsibbo: ben kanfe hakkeruvim. nirdi natan recho, degarmu leistalleka mibbenehon.

Davar acher, ad shehammelech bimsibbo, beod dekudesha berich hu hava yahiv orayyta leyisrael, dichtiv, (Shemot 34:28) vayhi sham im Adonai arbaim yom vearbaim layla lechem lo achal vegomer. beod dehava ketiv orayyta leyisrael, shavku rechehon tav, veamru elle elohecha yisrael.
Davar acher ad shehammelech bimsibbo, beod dehava kudesha berich hu nachit al tura desinay, lemihav orayyta leyisrael, nirdi natan recho, dichtiv, (Shemot 24:7) naase venishma.

Ribbi tanchum amar, kol uma veuma it lah sar leella, vechad kudesha berich hu yahiv shultanuta leden, anchit leden, vechad yahiv shultanuta lehahu sar, let leh shultanuta, ella begin yisrael, hada hu dichtiv, (Eicha 1:Adonai) hayu tzareha lerosh.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, yisrael innun lokovel kol shear umin dealma, ma shear ammin innun shivim, uf yisrael innun shivim, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 46:27) kol hannefesh levet yaakov habbaa mitzrayma shivim. uman deshalit al yisrael, keillu shalit al kol alma.
Ribbi abba amar mehacha, uvene yisrael paru vayyishretzu vegomer, ha shiva. vechol darga (nusach acher salleka) laasara, ha shivim. ma ketiv batreh, vayyakam melech chadash al mitzrayim.

Amar rav huna, amay ishtaavidu yisrael bechol haumin, begin deyishtear behon alma, deinnun lokovel kol alma, uchetiv, (Zecharya 14:9) bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. uma hu chad, uf yisrael chad, dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 7:23) goy echad baaretz. ma shemeh chad, unitperash be, uf yisrael chad, unitperash beshivin.
Ribbi yehuda patach, (Mishlei 30:22) tachat shalosh ragza eretz vegomer, tachat eved ki yimloch, detanya
531: Let lach uma mekicha ukelila venivzet kame kudesha berich hu, kevavtayyhu demitzrae, veyahiv lon kudesha berich hu shultanuta beginayyhu deyisrael. veshifcha ki tirash gevirtah, da hagar, deolidat leyishmael, sheasa kamma raot leyisrael, veshalat bahem, veinna otam bechol mine innuyin, vegazar alehem kamma shemadot, vead hayyom hem sholtim alehem, veenam mannichim lahem laamod bedatam. veen lach galut kasha leyisrael kemo galut yishmael.

Ribbi yehoshua hava selik lirushalim, vahava azil beorcha, chama chad arbaa, dehava azil beorcha, uvereh immeh. pagu beyuday chad. amar livreh, hay yuday gaala, demais beh mareh. nevol leh, verakik leh bedikneh 7 zimnin, deihu mizzara deramin, daana yadana dimshabedan behu shivin amamin, azil bereh veachid bedikneh. amar ribbi yehoshua ramin ramin, gozarna al illain, deyechtun letatta. ad la siyyem itbelau beatrehon.

Ribbi yitzchak patach, (Shir HaShirim 2:17) ad sheyyafuach hayyom venasu hatztzelalim vegomer, ad sheyyafuach hayyom, hay kera al galuta deyisrael ittemar, deinnun yishtabedun begaluta, ad deyistayyem hahu yoma deshultanuta deumin. ditnan, amar ribbi yitzchak, elef shenin hu shultanuta dechol umin kachada, alayyhu deyisrael. velet lach uma dela yishtabed behon. veyoma chada, hu lokovle dichtiv, (Zecharya 14) vehaya yom echad hu yivvada laAdonai vegomer.

Davar acher, ad sheyyafuach hayyom kodem deyafuach hahu yoma deumin. venasu hatztzelalim, innun shuletanin deshaltu alayyhu. elech li el har hammor, amar kudesha berich hu, elech li, lenara haumot miyrushala 40 dehu har hammor, kema dichtiv, behar hammoriyya asher biyrushala 40. veel givat hallevona, da be makdesha di betziyyon, dichtiv beh (Tehillim 48:3) yefe nof mesos kol haaretz har tziyyon vegomer, (amar rabbi yehuda) kema deat amer, (Iyov 38:13) leechoz bechanfot haaretz veyinnaaru reshaim mimmenna. kehay deachid betalit, lenaara tinnufa minnah.

Amar ribbi yose, atid kudesha berich hu leitgalyay biyrushala 40 diltatta, uledakkea yatah mittinnufe amamya, ad dela ishtelim hahu yoma deumin. deamar ribbi chiyyay, let shuletanu leumin alayyhu deyisrael, ella yoma chada lechod, dehu yomo shel hakadosh baruch hu, vehu elef shanim. hada hu dichtiv, (Eicha 1:13) netanay shomema kol hayyom dava. yoma chad lechud, vela yattir.

Amar ribbi yose, i yattir yishtabedun, lo al pum gizrat malka hu, ella al dela bayayn lemeyhadar lokovleh, uchetiv (Devarim 30:1) vehaya ki yavou alecha kol haddevarim haelle vegomer, uchetiv, (Devarim 30:4) im yihye niddachacha biktze hashshamayim misham yekabbetzcha vegomer.

(Shemot 1:9) vayyomer el ammo hinne am bene yisrael. amar ribbi shimon ta chaze, deha al kol panim malacha shiltona dimmana al mitzrae hava, vehachi hu, deruva defarsheta la ittemar, ella melech mitzrayim (10 amud alef) setam, vehayeynu memana ravreva al mitzrae. paro melech mitzrayim, paro mammash.

Amar ribbi shimon, lefichach ketiv, vayyomer (Bereshit 234 amud bet) kelomar achnis belibbehon milleta da, kema deat amer, (Shmuel 2 16:10) ki Adonai amar lo (lecha) kallel et david. machashevet hallev bilvad. vechen (Ester 6:6) vayyomer haman belibbo, vechen (Bereshit 17:17) vayyomer belibbo halleven mea shana. uf hacha name, achnis machashavta belibbehon, deamru rav veatzum mimmennu. may mimmennu. retzono lomar memana dilhon, innun amru belibbayyhu, dechela vetukepa dillehon, ravreva vetakkifa mimmennu, mishuletana dilhon.

Rabbi yitzchak amar, kol umin dealma, (bar yisrael) mashchin tukepa missarehon, veyisrael nagdin chelehon mikudesha berich hu, veinnun itkerun amma daAdonai, vela amma deshuletanayya. Rabbi yehuda amar, hacha itkerun ammo, dichtiv vayyomer el ammo, vehatam ketiv, (Shemot 3:7) rao raiti et oni ammi, ammi mammash, yisrael ikrun am Adonai, ushear umin ikrun, ammo deshuletana dilhon dichtiv, (Micha 4:Adonai) ki kol haammim yelchu ish beshem elohav vaanachnu nelech beshem Adonai elohenu leolam vaed.

Amar ribbi abba, hay pesuka, hava leh lememar (hinne im yisrael o) bene yisrael rav veatzum mimmennu, (ella) mahu am bene. ella am bene yisrael mammash, mehahu yisrael dilella, dachashivu deam bene yisrael havo, velo am Adonai, uchetiv (Shemot 1) vayyakutzu mippene bene yisrael, vela ketiv mippene
532: Am bene yisrael, ella mippeni bene yisrael mammash.

Ribbi yochanan hava kaim kameh der yitzchak, amar, me chama balak lememar (Bamidbar 22:5) hinne am yatza mimmitzrayim, velo amar hinne am bene yisrael. (ella) amar leh Rabbi yitzchak, balak mechashshef gadol hava, vechen derech hamechashshefim lakachat haddavar sheen bo chashada, vechen en mazkirin leolam shem aviv shel adam, ella shem immo, davar sheen bo chashada.

Dechen derech hashshedim, dimayyeynim behahu milla dekamre lehu, i ihu kediva, modiin leh millin kedivin, vei hu keshot, kol ma deamrin lezimna zeera kusheta hu, kol shekken lemebad avidta. ribbi acha amar, balak orcha dekalana nakat, hinne am yatza mimmitzrayim, kelomar, delet anan yadin mimman innun.

Amar ribbi yochanan, mippene ma amma deravrevin netirin, veamma dekudesha berich hu la netirin. amar ribbi yitzchak, la dame miskena laatira. miskena bae lenatra dileh, atira la natir dileh, vechol shekken deyisrael, innun mimmalka derachim keshot vedina. vedina kadmaa avid beguverin deveteh, devae deinnun lehvavn netirin mechattaa yattir mikkullehu hada hu dichtiv, (Amos 3:2) rak etchem yadati mikkol mishpechot haadama vegomer.

Ribbi yose nafak laorcha, vahava ribbi acha bar yaakov azil immeh, ad dahavo azle shatik ribbi yose, vehirher bemille dealma. veribbi acha hirher bemille deorayyta. (74 dahavo azle) chama ribbi yose chad chivya, dehava rahit avatreh. amar ribbi yose leribbi acha, chazet hay chivya derahit avatray. amar leh ribbi acha, ana la chamena leh. rahat ribbi yose vechivya avatroy. nafal ribbi yose, vedama shatat venachat mechotamoy, shama dahavo amrin, rak etchem yadati mikkol mishpechot haadama vegomer, amar ribbi yose, uma al shaata chada kach, man demityayesh minnah al achat kamma vechamma.

Patach veamar, (Devarim 2:7) ki Adonai elohecha berachcha bechol maase yadecha yada lechtecha vegomer hammolichcha vegomer, nachash saraf veakrav vegomer, nachash saraf lamma hacha. ella, lakachat onshan miyyisrael, kol zeman shemmitparshin min etz hachayyim. dichtiv, (Devarim 30:20) ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha.

Ta chaze, amar ribbi chiyyay, ketiv (Mishlei 13:24) chosech shivto sone veno vegomer. uchetiv (Malachi 1:2) ahavti etchem amar Adonai. uchetiv, (Malachi 1:2) veet esav saneti. mahu saneti, dichtiv chosech shivto sone veno. kelomar saneti oto, veal ken chasachti shevet mehem, kol shekken vechol shekken talmide chachamim, dela bae kudesha berich hu deyitparshun meetz hachayyim afilu riga chada.

Vayyomer el ammo. yahav lehon eta, lemebad immehon bisha. amar ribbi tanchum, yadin havo mitzrae beitztagninut dilhon, shessofan lemilke begin yisrael, ulechach akdim shuletana dillehon, lemebad immehon bish.

Ribbi yitzchak paga behahu tura, vechama chad bar nash dehava naim techot chad ilan. yativ tamman, adhava yativ, chama ara demitchalchala, veittebar hahu ilana, venafal, vechama bekiin gummin beara, veara salleka venachta.

Ittear hahu gavra, tzavavch lokovleh deribbi yitzchak, veamar leh yuday yuday, beche venahim, dehaiddana mekimin birkia chad ravreva memana shultana illaa, vehu zamin lemebad immechon bish saggi, vehay rigsha deara beginechon hava. dechol zimna deragsha ara, kad kam memana, deyaaved immechon bisha.

Tavav ribbi yitzchak veamar, vadday ketiv, (Mishlei 30:22) tachat shalosh ragza eretz, uchetiv tachat eved ki yimloch. memana dehava (memana) techot shultana achara, umalich, veyahavin leh shultana, vekol shekken kad shalit beyisrael.
Amar ribbi chama bar gureya, kad anach leyisrael techot shultanuta deumin, yativ vegae uvache, hada hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 13:17) bemistarim tivke nafshi. amar ribbi yose, bemistarim davvka.
Ribbi yehuda al legabbeh deribbi elazar, ashkacheh dehava yativ, videh befumeh, vahava atziv. amar leh, bemay
533: Ka asik mor. amar leh dichtiv, (Mishlei 16:15) beor pene melech chayyim. i tarna atziv, vekol shekken degae uvache, shammashoy may avde, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:7) hen erellam tzaaku chutza. may chutza. marehon bego, veinnun levar. marehon bevatte gavay, veinnun bevatte baray. batte gavay may innun. amar ribbi yitzchak, innun measara kitre malka.

Malache shalom mar yivkayun, vechi yesh malachim sheenam shel shalom. amar leh in. ta chaze, it mare dedina kashya, veit mare dedina dela kashya, veit mare dina verachamanuta. veit mare derachamanuta delet behu dina kelal. veillen itkerun malache shalom. veal innun diltatta, ketiv, (Yeshayahu 50:3) albish shamayim kadrut vesak asim kesutam. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 34:4) venamakku kol tzeva hashshamayim.
I hachi, kol innun shuletanin dimmanan al shear ammin, kad chaman lemarehon atziv, lemay avdin parocha livnohi. amar ribbi elazar, la avdi ella may deitpekadu, ureuta demarehon avdin.

Rabbi dostay amar beidana deitmasseran benoy dekudesha berich hu, leshuletane amamin, mitkannefin teresar batte dinin, umishtakkean go tehoma rabba, gae tarna, gain, urehitan (nusach acher terisin) venachtin teren dimin lishkia deyamma rabba, hada hu dichtiv (Tehillim 36:7) mishpatecha tehom rabba. umitgalgelan illain letatta, itbakkean tattain, venachtin matan vearbein dargin hada hu dichtiv, (Amos 3:8) arye shaag mi lo yira.

Tanna, beshaata demasar kudesha berich hu leyisrael lesara demitzrae, gazar alayyhu 7 gezerot, sheyshaabbedu behon mitzrae. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 1:14) vaymarru et chayyehem baavoda kasha bechomer uvilvenim vegomer. velokovlehon shiva letav, uvene yisrael paru, vayyishretzu, vayyirbu, vayyaatzmu, bimod, meod, vattemale haaretz otam.

(Shemot 1:10) hava nitchakkema lo. ribbi yose amar, en hava ella lashon hazemana, lemebad dina. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 11:7) hava nerda. (Shmuel 1 14:41) hava tamim. amar ribbi yochanan, hava kullam, leshon hasekama vehazemana. kemo (Bereshit 11:4) hava nivne lanu ir. (Shoftim 20:7) havu lachem etza. (Tehillim 29:1) havu laAdonai bene elim.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, hava nitchakkema lo nehve vehasekamat dina legabbeh. pen yirbe, veruach hakkodesh omeret ken yirbe, vechen yifrotz. umalache hasharet havo lehu lesikkim velitzninim hada hu dichtiv, vayyakutzu mippene bene yisrael. dahavo mitakketze mimmalache hashsharet, kehane kotze demitakketze behu inshe.

Amar ribbi yuday amar ribbi yitzchak, ma hava machashavtehon demitzrae, demimna miyyisrael pirya ureviyya, veshultana dimmana alehon deail belibbehon kach. ella, amar lehon, havo yadin, dezammin bera chada lemefak miyyisrael, deyitaved dina beelohehon al yedeh.

Deamar ribbi yochanan, beshaa sheamar moshe, (Shemot 12:12) uvechol elohe mitzrayim eese shefatim halach duma saro shel mitzrayim, 4 meot parsa. amar leh kudesha berich hu, gezera nigzera lefanay, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 24:21) yifkod Adonai al tzeva hammarom bammarom vegomer. beota shaa nittela hasserara mimmennu, venitmanna duma sar shel gehinnam, lidon sham nafshot harshaim. veribbi yehuda omer al hammetim nitmanna.

Amar ribbi chanina, ketiv (Bamidbar 33:4) uvelohehem asa Adonai shefatim. vechi beeloah shel kesef, veshel zahav, veshel etz, veshel even, yesh shefatim. ella amar ribbi yose, shel kesef veshel zahav hayu nittachim mealehem, veshel etz mitrakkevin.

Amar ribbi elazar, eloah shel mitzrayim se haya, vetzivva hakadosh baruch hu laasot bo shefatim, lisrof oto baesh, kema deat amer, (Devarim 7:25) pesile elohehem tisrefun baesh. kede sheyyehe recho nodef. veod, (Shemot 12:9) rosho al keraav veal kirbo. veod, sheatzmotav mushelachim bashshuk. vezot hayta lemitzrayim kashe mikkullan, hada hu dichtiv, shefatim.

Amar ribbi yehuda belohehem mammash vezehu sar shellahem, lekayyem, yifkod Adonai al tzeva hammarom bammarom veal malche haadama al haadama. vechol ze hayu yodim hachachamim shebbahem, vekol shekken sar shellahem. al ken ketiv, hava nitchakkema lo.
Ribbi yochanan amar, harebe avoda zara hayu bemitzrayim, venilus eloah
534: Shellahem haya, uvichlal elohehem haya hu, uvechullam asa Adonai shefatim. amar ribbi abba, ha der yochanan dayyka, ufeshita, mishshum deelohehem nilkim battechilla, veachar kach hauma, vechen nilus nilka battechilla, vehaetzim vehaavanim, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 7:21) vayhi haddam bechol eretz mitzrayim uvaetzim uvaavanim, shehayu lahem elohut mammash. veamar ribbi yitzchak, al tzeva hammarom bammarom ketiv, venilus lo haya bammarom. amar ribbi yochanan, rov memav kedugematan bammarom. amar ribbi yitzchak, sar shellahem nilka battechilla, veachar kach shear elohehem.

Ribbi shimon beribbi yose omer, lakut uma shel mitzrayim mammash, la haya ella bayyam, dichtiv, (Shemot 14:28) lo nishar bahem ad echad. vekodem ze, naasa shefatim belohehem. veal da ketiv, hava nitchakkema lo pen yirbe vehaya ki tikrena. venitnabbeu al heatid, kefi ma sheera lahem. venosaf gam hu al sonenu, nibbeu al machanot elyonim, sheyyihyu sheruyim betocham. venilcham banu, nibbeu al ma dichtiv, (Shemot 14:14) Adonai yillachem lachem vegomer. veala min haaretz, kema deat amar (Shemot 14:8) uveni yisrael yotzim beyad rama.

(Shemot 2:1) vayyelech ish mibbet levi vayyikkach et bat levi. ribbi elazar patach, (Shir HaShirim 1:1) shir hashshirim asher lishlomo. tana, keshebbara hakkadosh baruch hu et olamo, ala bechefetz lefanav, uvara et hashshamayim bimino vehaaretz bismolo, veala bechefetz lefanav, linhog hayyom vehallayla. uvara hammalachim hamemunim bechasdo, bayyom. (nusach acher lomar shira beyom zeman hachesed) uvara hammalachim hamemunim lomar shira ballayla. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi. ellu miyyamin, veellu missemol, ellu makshivim shirat hayyom, shiratam shel yisrael kadosh. ribbi yitzchak amar, otam sheomrim shira ballayla, makshivim shiratam shel yisrael bayyom, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 8:13) chaverim makshivim lekolech.
Amar ribbi shimon, kat achat, kelula mishshalosh kittot, omeret shira ballayla. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah.

Amar ribbi elazar, asara devarim nivrau beyom rishon, mehem middat layla, umehem middat yom, veal middat layla ketiv, vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah. kema deat amer, (Iyov 16:9) appo taraf. uchetiv, (Micha Adonai:7) vetaraf veen matztzil. vechok lenaaroteha, kema deat amar (Shemot 15:25) chok umishpat. (Tehillim 147:19) chukkav umishpatav. (tehillim 81) ki chok leyisrael hu mishpat vegomer. mikkan shemiddat haddin sholetet ballayla.

Vetana, ellu haomrim shira ballayla, ellu hem sarim al kol baale shir. uchesheppotchin hachayyim shira, mosifim haelyonim koach, ladaat ulehakkir ulehassig ma shello hissigu. shamayim vaaretz, mosifin koach behay shira.

Amar ribbi nechemya, ashre hazzoche ladaat beoto shir, detanya hazzoche beoto shir, yada beinyane hattora vehachachma, veyaazin veyachakor veyosif koach ugevura bamme shehaya, uvamme sheatid lihyot, uvaze zacha shelomo ladaat.

Detane ribbi shimon, david alav hashalom, yada baze, vetikken shirim vetushebachot harebe, veramaz bahem haatidot lavo, vehosif choach ugevura beruach hakkodesh. yada beinyayni hattora vehachachma, veizzen vechikker vehosif koach ugevura belashon hakkodesh.

Ushelomo zacha yoter beoto hashshir, veyada hachachma, veizzen vechikker vetikken meshalim harebe, veasa sefer meoto hashshir mammash, vehayeynu dichtiv, (Kohelet 2:8) asiti li sharim vesharot. kelomar, kaniti li ladaat shir, meotan hashshirim haelyonim, vaasher tachtam. vehayeynu dichtiv, shir hashshirim, kelomar, shir, shel otam sharim shel mala. shir, shekkolel kol inyeyne hattora vehachachma, vechoach ugevura, bemma shehaya, veatid lihyot, shir hashshirim shel mala meshorrim.

Amar ribbi elazar, ellu hasharim, amdu, ad shennolad levi, aval mishshennolad levi veelach amru shir. kevan shennolad moshe venimshach aharon, venitkaddeshu halleviyyim, nishlam hashshir, veamdu al mishmerotam.
Veamar ribbi elazar, beota shaa shennolad levi, patchu lemala veamru, (Shir HaShirim Adonai) mi yittenecha keach li yonek shede immi
535: Emtzaacha vachutz eshshakcha gam lo yavuzu li. kevan sheyyatzu mishshevet levi hammeshorrim shel matta, venitkaddeshu kullam, veamdu al mishmerotam, venitkaddeshu elle lenochach elle, chaverim keechad, vehaolamot echad, umelech echad shochen alehem, ba shelomo, veasa sefer meoto shir shel otam sharim, venistam hachachma bo.

Amar ribbi yehuda, lamma nikreu hasharim shel matta leviyyim, al shennilvim venechbarim lemala keechad. vehashshomea, nilva venidbak nafsho lemala. veal ken amra lea, (Bereshit 29:34) yillave ishi elay. ribbi tanchum amar, shebbakkol nilva zera levi im hashshechina, bemoshe veaharon umiryam, uvechol zaro acharav, vehem hannilvim el Adonai lesharto.

Ta chaze, beshaa sheamdu hammeshorrim lemala, lo amdu al mishmartam, ad shennoldu shelosha haachim: moshe, aharon, umiryam. tinach moshe veaharon, miryam lamma. amar ribbi yose, hada hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 2) vesharot. kema deat amer, (Shemot 15:21) vattaan lahem miryam.

Tana, beota shaa shennolad levi, netalo hakadosh baruch hu, uvecharo mikkol echav vehoshivo baaretz, veholid likhat, ukehat holid leamram, vehu holid leaharon umiryam. perash meishto, vehechozirah, beota shaa hayu hameshorrim shel mala omdim umeshorrim, gaar bahem hakadosh baruch hu, venishtakkach hashshir, ad shennata kav yemino, vehoshit leamram.

May tama nikra amram. sheyyatza mimmennu am ram al kol ramim, velo nizkar shemo. may tama lo nizkar shemo. ribbi yehuda amar beshem ribbi avahu, mippene shebbetzina halach, uvetzina chazar leishto, kede shello yakkiru bo, hada hu dichtiv vayyelech ish, vela neemar vayyelech amram befarhesya. vayyikkach et bat levi, af hi betzina chazra, velo nizkera shemah.

Vayyelecha ish. ribbi avahu amar, vayyelech ish, ze gavriel. dichtiv, (Daniel 9:21) vehaish gavriel. shehalach hu vehechozirah leamram. ribbi yehuda amar, amram mammash haya, velo nizkar shemo, mippene shehalicha zo lo hayta mimmennu lehizdavvevg leishto, ella millemala.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, beaharon umiryam lo neemar ziuug avotam battora, uvemoshe ketiv vayyikkach et bat levi, lehorot, shehashshechina nikret al shem levi. velo haya amram rauy leholid lemoshe, ad shennatal chelek bashshechina, veholid lemoshe. hada hu dichtiv, vayyikkach et bat levi. ulefichach ketiv, (Shemot 2:1) vattere oto ki tov hu.

Ribbi elazar amar, zacha amram sheyyatza mimmennu ben, shezzacha lekol gadol, dichtiv, (Shemot 19:19) vehaelohim yaanennu bekol. veamram zacha levat kol, dichtiv vayyikkach et bat levi. kelomar, bat kol. ulefichach ketiv vayyelech. kelomar, shehalach lemadrega zo. tana, keshennolad moshe, yiched hakadosh baruch hu shemo alav, dichtiv vattere oto ki tov hu. uchetiv, (Tehillim 145:9) tov Adonai lakkol. uchetiv, (Tehillim 34:9) taamu ureu ki tov Adonai.

(Shemot 2:23) vayhi vayyamim harabbim hahem. ribbi yehoshua desachnin amar, vayhi vayyamim harabbim hahem, sof galutam haya, shehayu yisrael meshuabbadim bechol avoda. bayyamim harabbim hahem, shehayu rabbim leyisrael bemitzrayim, vechevan shennishtallam ketz galutam, ma ketiv, vayyamat melech mitzrayim. may tama. shehurad sar mitzrayim mimmaalato, venafal miggaavato. vechevan shennafal melech mitzrayim, shehu sar shellahen, zachar hakadosh baruch hu leyisrael, veshama tefillatam.

Amar ribbi yehuda, bo uree shekkach hu, shekkol zeman shehasar shellahem nitna lo serara al yisrael, lo nishma tzaakatam shel yisrael, kevan shennafal hassar shellahem, ketiv vayyamat melech mitzrayim, umiyyad vayyeanchu bene yisrael min haavoda vayizaku vattaal shavatam el haelohim. shead otah shaa lo naanu betzaakatam.

Amar ribbi elazar, bo uree rachamanuto shel hakkadosh baruch hu, keshehu merachem al yisrael, kofe lemiddat haddin, umoridah, umerachem alehem. vehayeynu ditnan, shehakkadosh baruch hu morid shete demaot layyam haggadol. man innun shete demaot. amar ribbi yose, lav
536: Milla berira hi, deha amar leh leova tamya, dehu kadiv, umile kedivan.

Amar ribbi elazar, lav batar ova tamya azlinan, divrira demilla hu, ditnan, baasara kitre malka, it teren dimin lekudesha berich hu, vehen shete middot din, shehaddin ba mishshetehen, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 51:19) shetayim hinne korotayich. ucheshehakadosh baruch hu zocher et banav, hu morid otam layyam haggadol, shehu (Vayikra 137 amud bet) yam hachachma lehametikan, vehofech middat haddin lemiddat rachamim, umerachem alayyhu. amar ribbi yehuda, shete demaot, shemmehem baim haddemaot, mehem ba haddin.

Amar ribbi yehuda ketiv, (Shemot 14:10) vehinne mitzrayim nosea acharehem. veamar ribbi yose ze sar shel mitzrayim hu, veat amart vayyamat melech mitzrayim, ze sar shel mitzrayim. amar ribbi yitzchak, hay milla ka mesayyea lehahu dilella, ketiv hacha vehinne mitzrayim, uchetiv hatam vayyamat melech mitzrayim. melammed deachshav lo haya melech, dehoriduhu miggedulato. ulefichach ketiv, vehinne mitzrayim, vela ketiv melech mitzrayim. uma deamar vayyamat. kema deat amer (Shemot 4:19) ki metu kol haanashim hamevakshim et nafshecha.

Amar ribbi yitzchak amar ribbi yehoshua, bo uree, kol malche mitzrayim paro shemam. uvechan lo neemar ella melech mitzrayim setam. uvimkomo paro, vehu paro mammash. ta chaze, beod deit shuletanuta dilella, it shuletanuta beamma diltatta, itade shuletanuta dilella, itade shuletanuta diltatta.

Amar ribbi yose, ketiv (Zecharya 14) hinni yom ba laAdonai vegomer vehaya yom echad hu yivvada laAdonai vegomer. vechi shear yomin lav innun dileh. ella amar ribbi abba, melammed, sheshshear hayyamim, nittanim lesarim, veoto yom, eno shel hassarim, ella shel hakadosh baruch hu, kede laasot din baavodat kochavim umazzalot. mippeni shebbeoto yom, yippelu kol hassarim mimmaalatam. veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 2:11) venisgav Adonai levaddo bayyom hahu. sheoto yom lo yihye maala lessarim.

Amar ribbi abba, keshehakadosh baruch hu ose din bassarim shel mala, ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 34:5) ki rivveta bashamayim charbi. vechi cherev it laAdonai. ella amar ribbi yitzchak, cherev it leh, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 34:5) cherev laAdonai mala dam. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 66:16) uvecharbo et kol basar.

Amar ribbi abba, hacherev hazze hu haddin sheose, dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 21:16) vayyar (david) et malach Adonai omed ben haaretz uven hashshamayim vecharbo shelufa beyado. vechi cherev shelufa hayta beyad hammalach, ella, shehayta harshut netuna beyado laasot din.

Veha amar ribbi yehoshua ben levi, amar li malach hammavet, i lav decheyysna likara deviryayta, parana lehu bet hashshechita, kabbehema. amar ribbi abba, kolla mishshum deityeyhiv reshuta bideh, lemebad gemar dina, hada hu dichtiv, (Yehoshua Adonai:13) vecharbo shelufa beyado, harshut netuna beyado laasot din. i hachi may (divrei hayamim 1 21:27) vayyashev charbo el nedanah. amar ribbi abba, shennechezar haddin levaal haddin, veharshut lemi sheharshut shello.
Vayyeanchu bene yisrael, vayyitannechu la ketiv, ella vayyeanchu, kelomar, nitannechu (sefer acher haanaychav) lo lemala (sefer acher kelomar neenchu lematta) shehaanacha hayta bishvilam lemala.

Rabbi berechya amar, bene yisrael dilella havo, uman innun bene yisrael. innun deitkerun bene pulechana. kelomar, otam shehem min haavoda shel mala. vattaal shavatam el haelohim, shead otah shaa la alta shavatam lefanav.

Amar ribbi yitzchak kad avid kudesha berich hu dina befamalyay shel mala, hahu dina may have. amar ribbi elazar, mabar lehu behahu nehar dinur, veabar lon mishshuletanehon, umane shuletanin acharanin dishar ammin. amar leh veha ketiv (Tehillim 104:4) meshartav esh lohet. amar leh, it eshsha kashya meeshsha, veit eshsha dedachya eshsha.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, telat inyayne hacha: anacha, shava, tzeaka. vechol chad mitparsha meachara. anacha: ketiv, vayyeanchu bene yisrael. tzeaka: dichtiv, vayyitzaku. shava: dichtiv, vattaal shavatam. vechol chad bilchodoy mitparsha, vechullehu avdu yisrael. amar ribbi yehuda, tzeaka veshava avdu, anacha la avdu, mashma middichtiv vayyeanchu ulemala hayta haanacha bishvilam.

Tzeaka veshava bemay itparshan, amar ribbi yitzchak, en lach shava, ella battefila. shenneemar, (Tehillim 39:13) shemaa tefillati Adonai veshavati haazina. (tehillim 88) elecha Adonai shivvati. (Tehillim 30:3) shivvati elecha vattirpaeni. tzeaka shetztzoek veeno omer kelum. amar ribbi
537: Yehuda, hilkach gedola tzeaka mikkullan, shetztzeaka hi ballev. hada hu dichtiv, (Eicha 2:18) tzaak libbam el Adonai. tzeaka uzeaka davar echad hu, veze kerova lehakadosh baruch hu, yoter mittefilla vaanacha, dichtiv, (Shemot 22:22) ki im tzaok yitzak elay shamoa eshma tzaakato.

Amar ribbi berechya, beshaa sheamar hakadosh baruch hu lishmuel, (Shmuel 1 15:11) nichamti ki himlachti et shaul lemelech. ma ketiv, vayyichar lishmuel, vayitzak el Adonai kol hallayla. hinniach hakkol, velakach tzeaka, mishshum dehi kerova lekudesha berich hu yattir mikkullehu, hada hu dichtiv, veatta hinne tzaakat bene yisrael baa elay.

Tanu rabbanan, hay man detzalle uvache vetzaik, ad la yachil lemirchash besifvavteh, hay tzelota shelemata dehi belibba, uleolam la hadera rekanayya. amar ribbi yehuda, gedola tzeaka, shekorea gezar dino shel adam mikkol yamav.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, gedola tzeaka, shemmoshelet al middat haddin shel mala. ribbi yose amar, gedola tzeaka, shemmoshelet baolam hazze uvaolam habba. bishvil tzeaka nochel haadam haolam hazze uhaolam habba, dichtiv, (Tehillim 107:6) vayyitzaku el Adonai batztzar lahem mimmetzukotehem yatztzilem.

(Shemot 3:1) umoshe haya roe et tzon yitro chotno kohen midyan. ribbi shimon patach, (Shir HaShirim 2:16) dodi li vaani lo haroe bashshoshannim. amar rabbi shimon, oy lahem labberiyyot, sheenam mashgichim veenam yodim, beshaa sheala bemachashava lifni hakkadosh berich hu, livro olamo, kol haolamot alu bemachashava achat, uvemachashava zu nivrau kullam, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:24) kullam bechachma asita. uvemachashava zu, shehi hachachma, nivra haolam hazze, vehaolam shel mala.

Nata yemino, uvara haolam shel mala. nata semolo, uvara haolam hazze, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 48:13) af yadi yasda eretz vimini tippecha shamayim. kore ani alehem yaamdu yachdav. vechullam berega achat (uveshaa achat) nivrau, veasa haolam hazze, keneged haolam shel mala. vechol ma sheyyesh lemala, kedugemato lematta. vechol ma sheyyesh lematta, kedugemato bayyam. vehakkol echad. bara baelyonim hammalachim, bara baolam hazze bene adam, bara bayyam livyatan, kema deat amer (782) lechabber et haohel lihyot echad.

Ketiv baadam, (Bereshit 9:6) ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam. uchetiv, (Tehillim 8:6) vattechasserehu meat meelohim. i beni nasha yakkirin beovadayyhu (nusach acher beovadoy) kol hay, veinnun mitabbedin (mittippa) meafar devera, bemma atyayn leshaava mineh. uvachar baelyonim, uvachar beyisrael, laelyonim la kara banim, lattachtonim kara banim. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem. hu kara lahem banim, vehem karu lo av, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 63:16) ki atta avinu. uchetiv dodi li vaani lo. hu bachar bi, vaani bacharti bo.

Haroe bashshoshannim, hu roe bashshoshannim, af al pi shehakkotzim saviv lahem, veen acher yachol lirot bashshoshannim kemoto. davar acher haroe bashshoshannim, ma shushan ze hu adom, umemav levanim, kach hakadosh baruch hu, manhig olamo, mimiddat haddin lemiddat harachamim. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:18) im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu.

Ribbi abba hava azil beorcha, vahava immeh ribbi yitzchak. adhavo azle, paga beinun veradim, natal chad ribbi abba bidoy vahava azil. paga behu ribbi yose, amar vadday shechinta hacha, vaana chamena bidoy deribbi abba, lemelaf chachmeta saggia, deha yadana, deribbi abba la natal hay, ella leachazaa chachmeta.

Amar ribbi abba, tiv beri tiv. yatvu. arach ribbi abba behahu varda, amar, vadday en haolam mitkayyem ella al hareach. deha chazena delet nafsha mitkayyeyma ella al recha. veal da, hadas bemotzae shabbat.

Patach veamar dodi li vaani lo haroe bashshoshannim. mi garam li, sheani ledodi vedodi li, mippene shehu manhig olamo bashshoshannim. ma shoshan yesh bo reach, vehu adom, motzkin oto, vehu mithappech lalavan, uleolam recho lo zaz. kach hakadosh baruch hu, manhig olamo bederech ze, sheilmale ken lo yitkayyem haolam bishvil haadam hachote. vehachote nikra adom, kema deat amar, im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg
538: Yalbinu, makriv karbano laesh shehu adom. zorek haddam, saviv lammizbeach shehu adom. middat haddin adom, motzkin oto, (hareach) veole heashan kullo lavan, veaz haadom nehpach lelavan, nehpach middat haddin lemiddat harachamim.

Veta chaze, kol middat haddin, en tzarich hareach shello, ella mitztzad odem. vehayeynu deamar ribbi yehuda, ma dichtiv, (Melachim 1 18:28) vayyitgoddu kemishpatam vegomer ad shefach dam alehem. ella hayu yodim, shello yassigu mimmiddat haddin kirtzonam, zulati baodem.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, veod, odem velavan nikrav leolam, vehareach ole mishshetehen. ma hashoshan adom velavan, kach reach hakkarban. vehakkarban, meadom velavan. bo uree mereach hakketoret, shehashemanim, mehem adumim, umehem levanim, kegon hallevona, shehu lavan, mar deror adom, vehareach ole meadom velavan. veal ken manhig olamo bashshoshannim, shehu adom velavan. uchetiv (Yechezkel 44:15) lehakeriv li chelev vadam.

Keneged ze, adam makriv chelbo vedamo, umitkapper lo, ze adom, veze lavan. ma hashshoshan shehu adom vehu lavan, en motzkin oto lachazor kullo lavan, ella baesh. kach hakkarban en motzkin oto lachazor kullo lavan, ella baesh. achshav, mi sheyyoshev betaanito, umakriv chelbo vedamo, eno nitzmak lachazor kullo lavan, ella baesh. 215, mittoch taanito shel adam, machalishin evarav, vegover alav haesh, uveotah shaa, tzarich lehakeriv chelbo vedamo beoto haesh, vehu hannikra mizbach kappara.

Vehayeynu deribbi elazar, kad hava yativ betaanita, hava metzalle veamar, galuy veyadua lefanycha Adonai elohay vilohe avotay, shehikravti lefanecha chelbi vedami, vehirtachti otam bachamimut chuleshat gufi, yehi ratzon millefanecha, sheyyehe hareach haola mippi beshaa zo, keriach haole mehakkarban baesh hammizbeach, vetirtzeni.

Nimtza, sheadam hu makriv betaanito hachelev vehaddam, vehareach sheole mippiv, hu mizbach kappara, ulefichach tiknu hattefilla bammakom hakkarban, uvilvad sheyyitkaven lema deamaran. amar ribbi yitzchak, mikkan ulehala ketiv, (Bamidbar 31:23) kol davar asher yavo baesh taaviru baesh vetaher. amar ribbi yose, keshehaya bet hammikdash kayyaym, adam makriv karbano beinyan ze, umitkapper lo. achshav, tefillato shel adam mechapper lo bimkom hakkarban, ki hay gavvna.

Davar acher, dodi li vaani lo haroe bashshoshannim. ma hashoshannim kotzin metzuyin betocham, af hakkadosh baruch hu, manhig olamo betzaddikim ureshaim. ma hashoshannim, ilmale hakkotzim, en hashoshannim mitkayyeymin. kach ilmale harshaim, en hatztzaddikim nikkarim. deamar ribbi yehuda, bemma hatztzaddikim nikkarim, mittoch sheyyesh reshaim, deilmale reshaim en hatztzaddikim nikkarim. davar acher haroe bashshoshannim, hammanhig olamo beshesh shanim, vehashsheviit shabbat laAdonai. davar acher bashshoshannim, beotam sheshshonim battora.

Umoshe haya roe et tzon yitro chotno kohen midyan. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Tehillim 23:1) mizmor ledavid Adonai roi lo echsar. kelomar, Adonai roi: Adonai haroe shelli. ma haroe manhig et hatztzon, umolicham lemire tov, lemire shamen, bimkom nachale mayim, meyashsher halichatan betzedek uvemishpat. af hakkadosh baruch hu, ketiv binot deshe yarbitzeni al me menuchot yenahaleni nafshi yeshovev.

Amar ribbi yose, derech haroe, linhog betzedek et tzono, leharechikam min haggazel, lehanehigam bemishor, vehashshevet beyado shello yattu yamin usemol. kach hakkadosh baruch hu, hu roe et yisrael lehanehigam bemishor, uvechol et hashshevet beyado shello yattu yamin usemol.

Davar acher umoshe haya roe, amar ribbi yose, teda lecha, shekkol zeman sheharoe chacham lenahel et tzono, hu muchan lekabbel ol malchut shamayim. im haroe shote, alav nikra (Mishlei 26:12) tikova lichsil mimmennu.
Amar ribbi yehuda, moshe chacham haya, uvaki linhog et tzono. bo uree, middavid, shenneemar (Shmuel 1 16:11) vehinne roe batztzon. lelammedcha sheddavid
539: Chacham gadol haya, vehaya roe tzono kaddin vechashshura. lefichach, asahu hakadosh baruch hu melech al kol yisrael. velamma tzon velo bakar. amar ribbi yehuda, yisrael nikraim tzon. shenneemar, (Yechezkel 34:31) veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem. uchetiv, (Yechezkel 36:38) ketzon kodashim ketzon yerushalayim.

Ma hatztzon, kesheyyikkarvu al hammizbeach, bishvilam zoche lechayye haolam habba. kach hammanhig leyisrael kaddin vechashshura, bishvilam zoche lechayye haolam habba. veod, haroe et hatztzon, keshehatztzon yoldot, haroe notel otam telaim becheko, kede shello yilleu veyiggau, umolicham achare immotam, umerachem alehem. kach hammanhig leyisrael, tzarich lehanehilam berachamim, velo beachzariyyot. vechen amar moshe, (Bamidbar 11:12) ki tomar elay, saehu vechekecha vegomer.

Ma haroe et hatztzon, keshehu roe tov, matztzil et hatztzon min hazzeevim, umin haarayot. kach hammanhig leyisrael, im hu tov, matztzilan min haavodat kochavim umazzalot, umiddin shel matta, umiddin shel mala, umadrichan lechayye haolam habba. kach moshe, roe neeman haya, veraa hakadosh baruch hu, shekkeday hu lirot et yisrael, beoto haddin mammash, shehaya roe et hatztzon, lakkesavim, kefi harauy lahen. vehannekevot kefi harauy lahen

Ulefichacha ketiv, umoshe haya roe et tzon yitro chotno, velo shello, deamar ribbi yose, vechi ma shennatan et tzifora bitto lemoshe, lo natan lo tzon uvakar, vahalo yitro ashir haya. ella moshe lo haya roe et tzono, kede shello yomru bishvil shehaya tzono immo, haya roe otan betov. velachen ketiv et tzon yitro chotno, velo et shello. kohen midyan, ribbi tanchum amar, af al gav shehaya oved kochavim umazzalot, bishvil sheasa immo chesed, haya roe tzono kaddin vechashshura, bemire tov shamen vedashen.

(Shemot 3:1) vayynhag et hatztzon achar hammidbar. ribbi yose amar, moshe, miyyom shennolad, lo zaza mimmennu ruach hakkodesh. raa beruach hakkodesh, sheoto midbar haya kadosh, umuchan lekabbel ol malchut shamayim alav. ma asa, hinhig et hatztzon achar hammidbar. ribbi yitzchak amar, achar hammidbar al kol panim, velo bammidbar, shello ratza sheyyikkansu betocho, ella hirchikam achar hammidbar.

(Shemot 3:1) vayyavo el har haelohim choreva, hu levaddo belo tzon. 211, hay avna, dimkabbela parzela, kad chame leh, (mechet) medalga ilove. kach moshe vehar sinay, keshniru ze im ze, dilleg alav. hada hu dichtiv, vayyavo el har haelohim choreva.

Amar ribbi abba, muchanim hayu misheshet yeme bereshit, ze im ze. veoto hayyom, nitraggesh hahar lemul moshe. vechevan sheraahu shennichnas letocho, vedilleg bo, amad hahar. melammed, shesmechim hayu ze im ze.

Amar ribbi yannay, (nusach acher rabbi yose) yodea haya moshe, sheoto har, har haelohim hu. dichtiv vayyavo el har haelohim. detnan, ma raa moshe beoto har, raa ofot shehayu porchim, uforsim kanfehem velo hayu nichnasim bo.

Ribbi yitzchak (nusach acher amar Rabbi yitzchak) omer, raa haofot porchim vetasim mishsham, venoflim leraglav shel moshe, miyyad hirgish bainyan, veheemid et hatztzon achar hammidbar, vehu nichnas levaddo.

(Shemot 3:2) vayyera (159 amud bet, 167 amud alef) malach Adonai elav belabbat esh mittoch hassene. ribbi tanchum omer, sheet hammincha hayta, shemmiddat haddin sholetet bo. ribbi yochanan amar, veha ketiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo. middat chesed kaamar, velo middat haddin. amar ribbi yitzchak, mishsheyyotze haor, ad shennote laredet, nikra yom, vehu middat chesed. mishshennote laredet, nikra erev, vehu middat haddin. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:Adonai) vayyikra elohim laor yom.
Amar ribbi yochanan, sheat hammincha hu, 46 shaot ulemata. detanya Rabbi yitzchak omer, mahu dichtiv, (Shemot 16:12) ben haarbayim tochlu basar uvabboker tisbeu lachem. ben haarbayim, dehu shaata
540: Dedina tochlu basar. uchetiv, (Bamidbar 11:33) habbasar odennu ben shinnehem veaf Adonai chara vaam. mishshum, deven haarbayim, dina demalchuta shalit. uvabboker tisbeu lachem, mishshum deikre chesed hahu shaata, uchetiv, (Tehillim 52:3) chesed el kol hayyom. uchetiv, (Bereshit 1:Adonai) vayyikra elohim laor yom. deihu mitztzafra.

Ribbi tanchum omer, da sumak, veda chivvavr. sumak: ben haarbayim. dichtiv, (Shemot 16:12) ben haarbayim tochlu basar. vechivvra: betzafra. dichtiv, uvabboker tisbeu lachem. ribbi yitzchak amar, ketiv, (Shemot 12:6) veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael ben haarbayim vegomer. dehu shaata lemebad dina. ribbi yehuda amar, yalfinan mishshene kevasim shebbechol yom, haechad mitkarev keneged middat hachesed, vehv keneged middat haddin.

Veamar ribbi yehuda, mahu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 28:4) et hakkeves haechad taase vabboker, vela ketiv et hakkeves harishon, ella et hakkeves haechad, meyuchad, keneged middat hachesed. divchol makom, sheni, lo neemar bo ki tov.

Ribbi tanchum amar, lefichach, yitzchak tikken tefillat hammincha, shehu keneged middat haddin. amar ribbi yitzchak, mikkan, (Yirmeyahu 6:4) oy lanu ki pana hayyom ki yinnatu tzille arev. ki pana hayyom: ze middat hachesed. ki yinnatu tzille arev: shekkevar gavar middat haddin. avraham tikken tefillat shacharit, keneged middat hachesed.

Tanu rabbanan, behahi shaata deal moshe letura desinay, may tama itgele leh beshalhove eshshata, dehu dina. amar ribbi yaakov (nusach acher keen) kean shaata hava (shaata) garim. Rabbi yose amar, kolla lechad giza ishtarsha. ketiv, vayyavo el har haelohim choreva. uchetiv, (Devarim 9:8) uvechorev hiktzaftem et Adonai. uchetiv, vayyar malach Adonai elav belabbat esh mittoch hassene. mittoch shehem atidim lihyot kassene, kehay dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:12) kotzim kesuchim baesh yitztzattu.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, mikkan lamadnu, rachamanuto shel makom al harshaim, dichtiv, vehinne hassene boer baesh, laasot bahem din barshaim, vehassene enennu ukkol, (laasot) en bahem kelaya. boer baesh, al kol panim remez, laesh shel gehinnam. aval hassene ennnu ukkol, lihyot bahem kelaya.

Davar acher vayyera malach Adonai elav belabbat esh. may tama lemoshe belabbat esh, velishar neviim la. amar ribbi yehuda, lav moshe kishar neviim. ditnan, man dekariv leeshsha beh ittokad, umoshe kariv leeshsha vela ittokad. dichtiv, (Shemot 20:18) umoshe niggash el haarafel asher sham haelohim. uchetiv, vayyar malach Adonai elav belabbat esh mittoch hassene.

Ribbi abba amar, hay demoshe, it leistakkela beh bechachmeta illaa, al ma ketiv, ki min hammayim meshitihu. man deitmeshach min mayya, (dina ilaa) la dachil minnura. detanya amar ribbi yehuda, meatar deitgezar moshe, la itgezar bar nash achara. amar ribbi yochanan, baasara dargin (Vayikra 282) ishtachlal. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. velo neeman beti. zakkaa chulakeh debar nash, demareh ashid keden aloy.

Amar rav dimi, veha ketiv (Devarim 34:10) velo kam navi od beyisrael kemoshe. veamar ribbi yehoshua ben levi, beyisrael lo kam, aval beumot haolam kam, umano bilam. amar leh, vadday shappir kaamart, ishtik. kad ata ribbi shimon ben yochay, atu, shaillu kameh hay milla.
