Patach veamar, kutifa dekarnate, itarva baafarsemona tava chas veshalom. ella, vadday kach hu, beumot haolam kam, umano bilam. moshe ovadoy leella, uvilam letatta. moshe, ishtammash bechitra kaddisha demalka illaa leella. uvilam, ishtammash bechitrin tattain dela kaddishin letatta. uvehahu gavvna mammash ketiv, (Yehoshua 13:22) veet bilam ben beor hakkosem hargu bene yisrael bacherev. vei salleka datach yattir, zil shail leatneh. ata ribbi yose, venashak yedoy, amar, ha chamida (nusach acher chamra) delibbay nafak levar.

Dehacha mashma, deit illain vetattain, yemina usemala, rachame vedina, yisrael vavodat kochavim umazzalot. yisrael, mishtammeshin bechitrin illain kaddishin. avodat kochavim umazzalot, bechitrin tattain dela kaddishin. illen dimina, veillen dismala, veal kol panim, mitparshin nevie illae minnevie tattae. nevie dekudesha, minnevie delav dekudesha.
541: Moshe, parish mikkol nevie, binnevua kaddisha illaa. kach hava bilam, parish mishshear nevie vochorashe, binnevua delav kaddisha letatta. veal kol panim moshe hava leella, uvilam letatta, vechamma dargin vedargin mitparshin benayyhu.

Amar ribbi yochanan amar ribbi yitzchak, moshe hava mehareher veomer, shemma chas veshalom yisrael yichlu behay avoda kasha, hada hu dichtiv, vayyar besivlotam. lefichach, vayyera malach Adonai elav belabbat esh vegomer, vayyar vehinne hassene boer baesh vegomer. kelomar, meshuabbadim hem baavoda kasha, aval vehassene enennu ukkol. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu parish lon mikkol ammin, vekara lon benin, dichtiv (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem.
542: Tzur olamim: tzayyayr almin. deha bitren atvavn, itberun almin, alma den, vealma deate. alma da, bedina itberi, veal dina kayyeyma, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:1) bereshit bara elohim. may tama, begin deyitnahagun beni nasha bedina, vela yifkun meorcha levar.

Ta chaze ketiv vaydabber elohim el moshe, gizyrat dina dekayyeyma aleh, ma ketiv leella, (Shemot Adonai:22) vayyashav moshe el Adonai, vayyomar adonay, beAlef dalet nun yod. chame tukepa demoshe, besheruta dinviuteh, la nach rucheh behay atar, amar, adonay lama hareota laam hazze vegomer, umeaz bati el paro ledabber bishmecha hera laam hazze vehatztzel lo hitztzalta et ammecha. man hu deyema keden, ella moshe, deyada, deha darga ochora illaa zammin leh.
Amar ribbi yitzchak, besheruta deityehiv leh beta, pakid lah, kevar nash defakid leveteh, veamar kol man devae bela dechilu. uf hachi moshe, leveteh kaamar, vela dachil.

Davar acher vaydabber elohim, gizrat dina, (begin kach) vayyomer elav ani Adonai, darga ochora derachame. vehacha itkashshar kolla kachada, dina verachame. hada hu dichtiv, vayyomer elav ani Adonai. amar ribbi shimon (nusach acher rabeyyvasey) i ketiv vaydabber elohim el moshe ani Adonai, havena amar hachi. ella la ketiv, ella vaydabber elohim el moshe bekadmita, ulevatar vayyomer elav ani Adonai, demashma darga batar darga.

Veamar ribbi yose, moshe, ilmale dehava mareh deveta, ish haelohim, itannash al ma deamar, aval begini hay, la itannash. levar nash denafal leh ketata bidvithu, veamar lah millin, sharat hi leitraama, kevan desharit milla, hava tamman malka, natal malka milla, vehi shatkat ufaskat lemallela. amar leh malka, vechi la yadat daana hu malka, umikkamay mallilat millin illen, kivyachol uf hachi moshe, vayyashav moshe el Adonai vayyomar adonay lama hareota vegomer. miyyad, vaydabber elohim el moshe, share leitraama, miyyad natal malka milla vayyomer elav ani Adonai vela yadat daana hu malka, umikkamay mallilat millin illen.

Vaera el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov beel shadday. amay shanne shema hacha meillen dilella. ella lemalka, dehava leh beratta, dela itnesivat, vahava leh rechima. kad bae malka lemallela behahu rechima, meshadder livratteh lemallela immeh, vahava malka al yeda divratteh, memallel immeh. ata zimna divratteh leitnasseva, hahu yoma deitnesivat, amar malka, karun lah livratta, kerusefuneya matronita. veamar lah, ad hacha, mallilna al yedach, leman demallilna mikkan ulehala ana ema levalich, vehu yema leman deitzterich. leyomin, amar lah balah millin kame malka, ad dehi sharat lemallela, natal malka milla, amar leh, velav ana malka, dead yoma da la mallil enash immi, ella al yeda divratti, (74 lo nesivat) vaana yahivna lach beratti, umallilna immach beitgalya, ma dela avidna leochora.

Kacha, vaera el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov beel shadday, kad ihi beveti vela itnesivat, vela mallilu immi anpin beanpin, kema deavidna lach. veat, besheruta demillulach, mallilat livratti kamay millin illen, ella begini kach, vaera el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov beel shadday ushemi Adonai lo nodati lahem, lemallela immehon bedarga da deimmach mallilna.

Ribbi yose (nusach acher rabbi yesa) patach, (Tehillim 24:1) ledavid (50 amud alef) mizmor laAdonai haaretz umeloah tevel veyoshve bah. haaretz: da ara kaddisha deyisrael, deihi kayyeyma leitshakyay minneh, uleitbarcha minneh bekadmita, ulevatar minnah itshakyay alma kolla. tevel veyoshve bah: da shear aran, deshatan minah, mena lan. dichtiv, (Tehillim 9:9) vehu yishpot tevel betzedek.
Ki hu al yammim yesadah, illen
543: Shiva ammudim, deara semicha alayyhu. veinnun shiva yammim. veyam chinneret shalta alayyhu. amar ribbi yehuda, la tema deshalta alayyhu, ella deitmalyay minnayyhu. veal neharot yechonneha, man innun neharot. ella, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 93:3) nasu neharot kolam yisseu neharot dachyam, innun neharot, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan, uvegin kach, veal neharot yechonneha.
Ta chaze, hay eretz, ikre eretz yisrael. yaakov deihu yisrael, amay la shalit al da kemmoshe, deha ketiv vaera el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov beel shadday vela yattir.

Ella, yaakov ha okimna, natal beta diltatta, veishtevik minneh beta dilella. veim beta diltatta, atkin beta dilella, bitresar shevatin, beshivin anafin, veha ukemuha. moshe, natal beta dilella, veshavik beta diltatta. veal da, ketiv beyaakov beel shadday. beel shadday mallil immeh kudesha berich hu, vela yattir. ushemi Adonai lo nodati lahem, lemallela immehon bedarga da deihu illaa.

Vaera el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov. amar ribbi chiyyay, tushebchan daavahan yaakov hava, dehu shelimu decholla. bechullehu ketiv, el avraham, el yitzchak, uveh ittosaf at chad, dichtiv, veel yaakov. ittosaf beh 6, leachazaa deihu shelema yattir mikkullehu. veim kol da, la zacha leishtammesha beh kemmoshe.

(Shemot 6:4) vegam hakimoti et beriti ittam latet lahem et eretz kenaan, begin deitgezaru. dechol man deitgezar, yarit ara, deha la yarit ara, ella tzaddik, vechol man deitgezar, ikre tzaddik. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz, kol man deitgezar, venatir hay at kayyayma, ikre tzaddik, ta chaze min yosef, dechol yomoy la ikre tzaddik, ad denatir hahu berit, at kayyayma kaddisha. kevan denatar leh, ikre tzaddik, yosef hatztzaddik.

Ribbi shimon hava yativ yoma, chad, veribbi elazar bereh, (immeh) veribbi abba immeh. amar ribbi elazar, hay kera dichtiv, vaera el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov vegomer. mahu vaera, vaadabber mibbae leh. amar leh, elazar beri, raza illaa ihu.

Ta chaze, it gavvnin demitchazyayn, veit gavvnin dela mitchazyayn. veillen veillen, innun raza illaa dimhemnuta, uvene nasha la yadin leh, vela mistakkelin beh veillen demitchazyayn, la zacha behu bar nash, ad deatu avahan, vekayymu alayyhu. veal da ketiv vaera, dechamu, innun gavvnin deitgalleyayn.

Uman gavvnin deitgalleyayn. innun deel shadday, deinnun goonin dechezu ilaa (nusach acher chezu digvavnin 161) veillen itchazyayn. ugevavnin dilella, setimin dela itchazzeyayn, la kaim inish alayyhu, bar memoshe. veal da ketiv, ushemi Adonai lo nodati lahem, la itgalleti lon bigvavnin illain. vei tema, daavahan la havo yade behu. ella havo yade, miggo innun deitgalleyayn.

Ketiv (Daniel 12:3) vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia umatzdike harabbim kakkochavim leolam vaed. vehammaskilim yazhiru, man innun maskilim. ella da hu, hahu chacham deyistakkal miggarmeh millin, dela yachylin bene nasha lemallela befuma, veillen ikrun maskilim. yazhiru kezohar harakia, man (zohar) hu harakia. da hu rekia demoshe, dekayyeyma beemtzaita, vehay zohar dileh, ihu satim, vela itgalleyay miggaven dilleh kayyeyma al hahi rekia dela nahir, deitchazyayn beh gavvnin, veinnun gavvnin af al gav deitchazyayn beh, la zahare kezihara begin deinnun gavvnin setimin.

Ta chaze, arba nehorin innun. telat minnayyhu setimin, vechad deitgalyay: nehora denahir. nehora dezihara. (veinnun) veihu nahir kizhiru dishmayya bedachyu. nehora deargevavna, denatil kol nehorin. nehora dela nahir istakkal legabbe illen, venatil lon. veitchazzeyayn innun nehorin beh, kaashashita, lokovel shimsha.
Veillen telat dekamran, setimin vekayyeymin al hay
544: Deitgalyay. veraza da (vaychi 226 amud alef) ena ta chaze, beena it telat gavvnin, deitgalleyayn reshimin beh, vechullehu la mizdahare, begin dekayyme binhora dela nahir. veillen innun kegavvna deinnun setimin dekayyme alayyhu veillen innun deitchazzeyayn laavahan, leminda innun setimin demizdaharin, miggo illen dela mizdahare. veinnun demizdahare veinnun setimin, itgalleyayn lemoshe, behahu rekia dileh. veillen kayyme, al innun gavvnin deitchazzeyayn beh beena.

Veraza da satim enach, veaschar galgallach, veyitgalleyayn innun gavvnin denaharin, demizdahare, vela ityeyhiv reshu lemechome, ella beayynin setimin, begin deinnun setimin illain, kayyeyme al innun gavvnin deitchazzeyayn, dela mizdahare.

Veal da karenan, moshe zacha beaspakalarya denahara dekayyeyma al hahu dela nahara. shear bene alma, behahu aspakalarya dela nahara. vaavahan havo chaman miggo illen gavvnin deitgalleyayn, innun setimin, dekayyme alayyhu deinnun dela naharin, veal da ketiv, vaera el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov beel shadday, beinnun gavvnin deitchazzeyayn.

Ushemi Adonai lo nodati lahem, illen gavvnin illain setimin dezaharin, dezacha behu moshe leistakkela behon. veraza da, deena satim vegalya. satim, chame aspakalarya denahara, itgalleyay, chame aspakalarya dela nahara. veal da, vaera, beaspakalarya dela nahara, deihu beitgalleyay, beh ketiv reiyya. beaspakalarya denahara deihu bistimu, ketiv beh yedia, dichtiv lo nodati. atu ribbi elazar veribbi abba venashku yedoy. bacha ribbi abba, veamar, vavy kad tistallak mealma, veyishtear alma yatom minach, man yachil leanhara millin deorayyta.

Patach ribbi abba veamar, (Shmuel 1 25:6) vaamartem ko lechay veatta shalom uvetcha shalom vechol asher lecha shalom. vaamartem ko lechay, vechi david la hava yada beh benaval, deihu amar begineh, vaamartem ko lechay, ella, hahu yoma, yoma tava derosh hashshana hava, vekudesha berich hu yativ bedina al alma, uvegin kudesha berich hu kaamar, vaamartem ko, lechay, lekashshera ko, lechay, dechol chayyin beh talyayn. veatta shalom, may veatta atta mibbae leh. ella, veatta kolla lekudesha berich hu kaamar, begin lekashshera kishra dimhemanuta vechadka yeot.

Mikkan olifna, deha levar nash (Bereshit 171 amud bet) chayyayva, asur leakdema leh shelam, vei itzterich, yakdim leh kedavid, devarich leh lekudesha berich hu, veitchazze divgineh kaamar. vei tema derammaut hava. lav. deha kol man desalik leh lekudesha berich hu, veitchazze divgineh kaamar, lav rammaut hu. uman deakdim shelam lezakkaa, keillu akdim leh lekudesha berich hu, kol shekken mar, deihu shelama leella vetatta.

Vaera el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov beel shadday ushemi Adonai lo nodati lahem. ribbi chizkiyya patach, (Tehillim 32:2) ashre adam lo yachshov Adonai lo avon vegomer. kamma innun bene nasha atimin, dela yadin, vela mistakkelan, al ma kayyaymin bealma. deha kudesha berich hu kad bara alma, aved leh levar nash bediyyukena dileh, veatkin leh betikkunoy, begin deyishtaddal beorayyta, veyehach beorchoy.

Deha kad itbere adam, meafra demakdesha diltatta ittakkan vearba sitre dealma, itchabberu behahu atar deikre be makdesha. veinnun arba sitrin dealma, itchabberu bearba sitrin, deinnun yesodin dealma, esh ruach vemayim veafar, veitchabberu arba sitrin (nusach acher yesodin) illen, bed yesodin dealma, veatkin minnayyhu kudesha berich hu chad gufa betikkuna illaa. vehay gufa, itchabbar mitteren almin, mealma da tattaa, umealma dilella.

Amar rabbi shimon, ta chaze, 4 kadmae innun raza dimhemanuta. veinnun avahan dechullehu almin. veraza dirticha illaa kaddisha. veinnun 4 yesodin: esh ruach vemayim veafar. illen innun raza illaa. (veilen inun avahan dechullehu almin avahan decholla) umeinnun nafkin, zahav vachesef unechoshet uvarzel. utechot
545: (Kagevanea deillen) ta chaze. esh ruach vemayim veafar, illen innun kadmae vesharashin dilella vetatta, vetattain veillain alayyhu kayyeymin. veillen innun arba, learba sitre alma, vekayyeymin bearba illen: tzafon, vedarom, umizrach, umaarav. illen innun arba sitrin dealma, vekayyeymin bearba illen. esh listar tzafon. ruach listar mizrach. mayim listar darom. begin dedarom cham veyavesh mayim karim velachim afar listar maarav. vearba illen, bearba illen ketirin, vechullehu chad, veillen avde arba mattachan, deinnun zahav vachesef unechoshet uvarzel ha innun teresar, vechullehu chad.

Ta chaze, esh hu bismala, listar tzafon, deha esh, tukepa dachamimuta beh, veyavishu dileh (ayyen bateykevaneym sefer acher amud alef) takkif. vetzafon behippucha dileh hu, veitmezig chad bechad veihu chad. mayim limina, vehu listar darom. vekudesha berich hu, lechabbera (leachzera) lon kachada, avid mizga da kemizga da.

Tzafon ihu kar velach, eshsha cham veyavesh. achlaf lon listar darom. darom, ihu cham veyavesh. mayim karim velachim. vekudesha berich hu mazig lon kechad denafke mayya middarom, vealin bego tzafon. umitztzafon nagde mayya. nafik eshsha mitztzafon, veal betukefa dedarom, umiddarom nafik tukepa dachamimuta lealma. begin dekudesha berich hu ozif da beda, vechol chad vechad ozif lechavreh middileh kadka chaze leh. kegavvna da ruach umizrach, begin deyozif kol chad lechavreh, veitkelil da beda, leitchabbera kechad.

Ta chaze, eshsha missitra da, mayim missitra da. veinnun machaloket. al ruach benayyhu, veachid litren sitrin. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:2) veruach elohim merachefet al peni hammayim. deha eshsha kaim leella besitra da. umayim kayyme al appe ara. rucha ail benayyhu, veachid litren sitrin, veafrish machaloket. afar, mayya kayyeyme aleh verucha veeshsha umekabbela mikkullehu, bechela ditlata illen dekayyeyme alah.

Ta chaze, ruach umizrach. mizrach, cham velach, ruach, (kor veyavesh sitra deihu yevesha) cham velach ihu, uvegini kach, achid litren sitrin, deha esh cham veyavesh, umayim karim velachim, ruach ihu cham velach, sitra deihu cham, achid beeshsha. sitra deihu lach, achid bemayya. veal da askim benayyhu, veafrish machaloket deesha umayya.

Afar ihu kar veyavesh, veal da mekabbel aleh kullehu, vechullehu avde beh avidtayyhu, umekabbela mikkullehu, leappaka bechelehon mezona lealma. begin devmaarav itachid afra, deihu kar veyavesh. vesitra deihu kar, achid batztzafon deihu kar velach, deha kerira itachid bikrira. begin kach tzafon itachid bammaarav besitra da. darom deihu cham veyavesh, behahu yeveshuta dileh, achid liveshuta demaarav besitra ochora, veitachid maarav bitren sitrin.

Vechen itachid darom bemizrach, deha chamimuta dedarom, itachid beh bachamimuta demizrach. umizrach itachid batztzafon deha lachuta dileh itachid belachuta detzafon. hashsheta ishtechach deromit mizrachit. mizrachit tzefonit. tzefonit maaravit. maaravit deromit vechullehu kelilan da beda, leishtalshela chad bechad.

Kegavvna da, tzafon avid dahava. demistera detukepa deeshsha, itavid dahava. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Iyov 37:22) mitztzafon zahav yeete. deesh itachid beafar, veitavid dahava. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Iyov 28:6) veafrot zahav lo. veraza da, shenayim keruvim zahav.

Mayim itachid beafar, ukeriruta belachuta avid kesef, hasheta ha afar itachid bitren sitrin, bazzahav uvakkesef, veityeyhiv benayyhu. rucha achid lemayim, veachid (haggaha temiha bema deamar ruach kor veyavesh sheim ken afar veruach shavim betivam aval yesh omrim ki ruach cham valech 0 veim ken nuchal lomar deachid ruach litren sitrin esh cham veyavesh veruach cham valech sitra deihu cham achid baesh vesitra deihu lach achid bemayya veafrish machloket deeshsha umayya. afar ihu kor veyavesh umayim karim valechaym vesitra deker achid beafar besitra deker ishtechach deafar mekabbel aleh kullehu begin kach achid litren sitrin deha esh cham veyavesh mayim kor valech ad kan)
546: Leesh, veappik teren kechad, deihu (Yechezkel 1:7) en nechoshet kalal. veafar dekamran, kad ihu bilchodoy, bivishu ukeriru dileh, nafik barzel, vesimanich, (Kohelet 10:10) im keha habbarzel vegomer

Vehay afar, itachid bechullehu, vechullehu avdin beh kegavvna dilhon. ta chaze, bela afar, let zahav vachasef unechoshet, deha kol chad vechad ozif lechavreh middileh, leitkashshera da beda. veitachid afar bechullehu, begin ditren sitrin achidan leh, eshsha umayya. verucha itkeriv beh, begin illen teren veavid beh avidta.

Ishtechach, dechad itchabbar afra bahadayyhu, avid veolid afra acharanin, kegavvna dilhon. kegavvna dezahav, olid afra (236 amud bet) susefita yeroka, deihu kegavvna dedahava mammash. kegavvna dechesef, olid oferet. kegavvna dinchoshet illaa, olid kesitra deihu nechoshet zuta. kegavvna devarzel, olid barzel, vesimanich (Mishlei 27:17) barzel bevarzel yachad.

Ta chaze, esh ruach mayim veafar, kullehu achidan da beda, veitkashsheran da beda. vela have behu piruda. veafar da, kad ihu olid levatar, la mitkashsheran da beda beinnun illae, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 2:10) umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim, beillen have piruda.

Begin deha afar, kad ihu olid bechela ditlat illae, appik arbea naharin, detamman mishtakkeche avne yekar, uvaatar chad innun, dichtiv sham habbedolach veeven hashshoham. veillen avne yakar innun teresar, veinnun learba sitre alma, lokovel teresar shevatin, dichtiv, (Shemot 28:21) vehaavanim tihyena al shemot bene yisrael shetem esre al shemotam. veillen teresar bakar, deinnun techot yamma.

Ta chaze, kol arbea sitrin illain dekamran, af al gav demitkashsheran da beda, veinnun kiyyuma dilella vetatta, kiyyuma dealma yattir ruach, begin decholla kayyeyma begineh, venafsha la kayyeyma ella berucha, dei gara rucha afillu riga chada, nafsha la yachilat leitkayyeyma, veraza da ketiv, (Mishlei 19:2) gam belo daat nefesh lo tov. nafsha belo rucha lav ihu tov, vela yachla leitkayyeyma.

Veta chaze, innun teresar dekamran, deinnun teresar avanin, innun teresar bakar, ditchot yamma. begin kach, natlu innun teresar nesiim, (Bamidbar 7:87) kol habbakar laola shenem asar farim vegomer. vecholla raza illaa hu, uman deyashgach bemillin illen, yashgach beraza dechachmeta illaa, deikar decholla beh.

Amar Rabbi shimon, ha deamar Rabbi chizkiyya, dechad bara kudesha berich hu leadam, meafra demakdesha diltatta itbere, meafra demakdesha dilella ityeyhiv beh nishmeta. kema dechad itbere meafra diltatta, itchabberu beh telat sitra yesode alma. hachi name kad itbere meafra dilella, itchabberu beh telat sitre yesode alma, veishtelim adam. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Tehillim 32:2) ashre adam lo yachshov Adonai lo avon veen berucho remiyya. ematay lo yachsov Adonai lo avon, bizman deen berucho remiyya.

Ta chaze, moshe ishtelim yattir meavahan, begin demallil immeh kudesha berich hu, middarga illaa yattir mikkullehu, umoshe penimaa deve malka illaa hava, veal da ketiv, vaera el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov vegomer, veha okimna mille.

(Shemot 6:6) lachen emor livni yisrael ani Adonai vehotzeti etchem. ribbi yehuda amar, hay kera ippecha hu, dichtiv vehotzeti etchem mittachat sivlot mitzrayim bekadmita, ulevatar vehitztzalti etchem meavodatam, ulevatar vegaalti etchem, hava leh lememar meikkara vegaalti etchem, ulevatar vehotzeti etchem. ella, ikkara decholla bekadmita, devaa kudesha berich hu levassera lon bishvacha decholla bekadmita.
Amar ribbi yose, veha shevacha decholla, velakachti etchem li leam vehayiti
547: Lachem lelohim, veamar leh levatar. amar leh, behahu zimna, let lehu shevacha ella yetzia. dechashivi dela yifkun meavdutehon lealmin, begin dahavo chaman tamman dechol asire dahavo benayyhu mekashru lon bekishra decharashe, vela yachlin lenafka mibbenayyhu lealmin. uvegin kach, ma dechaviv alayyhu mikkolla, itbassaru beh.

Vei tema af al gav denafku, ha dilma yizzelun (chaylayhav) batrayyhu leavasha lon, ketiv vehitztzalti etchem meavodatam. vei tema ha yifkun veyishtezvun, vela yehe lon ferika, talmud lomar vegaalti etchem bizroa netuya. vei tema lo yekabbelem, ha ketiv velakachti. vei tema kesheyyekabbelem lo yeviem laaretz, ha ketiv veheveti etchem vegomer.

Raya mehemna (Shemot 6:7) velakachti etchem li leam vehayiti lachem lelohim vidatem ki ani Adonai elohechem vegomer pikkuda da kadmaa dechol pikkudin. reshita kadmaa dechol pikkudin, leminda leh lekudesha berich hu bichlala. may bichlala. leminda deit shallita illaa, deihu ribbon alma, uvara almin kullehu, shemayya veara vechol chelehon. veda ihu bichlala. vesofa decholla bifrat, leminda leh bifrat.

Uchelal uferat ihu resha vesofa raza dechar venukeba kachada, veishtechach bar nash behay alma, deitassak bichlal uferat, bar nash behay alma ihu kelal uferat. tikkuna dehay alma, ihu kelal uferat. begin kach, rishita decholla, leminda deit shallit vedayyayn al alma, veihu ribbon kol almin. uvara leh levar nash meafra, venafach beappoy nishmeta dechayye, veda ihu beorach kelal.

Kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, la havo yade leh lekudesha berich hu kevan deata moshe legabbayyhu, pikkuda kadmaa da olif lon, dichtiv, vidatem ki ani Adonai elohechem hammotzi etchem vegomer. veilmale pikkuda da, la havo yisrael mehemnin, bechol innun nissin ugevuran deavad lon bemitzrayim. kevan deyadu pikkuda da beorach kelal, itavidu lehon nissin ugevuran.

Ulesof 40 shenin, deka ishtedalu bechol innun pikkudin deorayyta, deolif lon moshe, ben innun demitnahage beara ben innun demitnahage levar meara keden, olif lon beorach perat, hada hu dichtiv, (dabeham 4) veyadata hayyom vehashevota el levavecha, hayyom dayyka, ma dela hava reshu mikkadmat dena. ki Adonai hu haelohim, da beorach perat, bemilla da, kamma razin vesitrin it bah. veda, vehahu dekadmeta, kolla milla chada, da bichlal, veda bifrat.

Vei tema, ha ketiv, (Mishlei 1:7) yirat Adonai reshit daat. tirutza, da beorach perat, leminda man ihu yirat Adonai. veaf al gav deit leh levar nash ledachala minneh, ad la yinda, aval hacha ketiv reshit daat, leminda leh deha ihu reshita, leminda leh beorach perat.

Begin kach, pikkuda kadmaa leminda leh lekudesha berich hu bichlal uferat, beresha uvesofa. veraza da (Yeshayahu 44:6) ani rishon vaani acharon. ani rishon bichlal, vaani acharon bifrat. vecholla bichlala chada, veraza chada. kevan deyinda da bichlal, yashlim kol shayyfoy. uman innun. 248 pikkudin, deinnun 248 shayyfin devar nash. kevan deishtelim behu al hay bichlal, keden yinda beorach perat, deda ihu asvavta lechullehu, veyinda kol yome shatta, demitchabberan lemehav asvavta lechol shayyfin.

Vei tema, kol yome shatta, hech yahavin asvavta lechol shayyfin. vadday hachi hu ella vetatta, shatta veyome dileh, yahavin asvavta lechol shayyfin ella vetatta, (bezimna) deshayyfin ariku birkan leyome shatta keden asvavta vechayyin talyayn alan milleella, veitmalyayn mikkolla. man garim lon. yome shatta.

Uf hachi name letatta, kad bar nash yashlim gufeh beinnun pikkudin deorayyta let lach kol yoma dela atyay leitbarcha minneh, vechad innun itbarchan minneh, keden chayyin veasvavta talyayn aleh milleella. man garim leh. innun yome shatta. yome shatta, kema deitbarchan milleella meraza
548: Deadam. hachi name itbarchan mittatta meraza deadam.

Zakkain innun yisrael behay alma, beillen pikkudin deorayyta, deikrun adam, dichtiv. (Yechezkel 34) adam attem. attem keruyim adam, veovde kochavim umazzalot la ikrun adam. uvegin deyisrael ikre adam, it lon leishtaddela beinnun pikkudin deorayyta, lemeheve kolla chad, beraza deadam.

Kad yahav kudesha berich hu orayyta leyisrael al tura desinay, milla kadmaa ihu anochi, anochi salleka lerazin (almin) saggiin. vehacha ihu raza defikkuda kadmaa, leminda leh bichlala. begin dichtiv anochi, ha ka ramiz, deit elaha shallita illaa (deihu) al alma, kema deat amer (Devarim 4:24) ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu, pikkuda kadmaa bichlal. bifrat: begin dichtiv, Adonai elohecha da perat, veda kelal uferat, pikkuda kadmaa, deitzterich leminda berisha uvesofa, kema deokimna. (ad kan raya mehemana).

(Shemot 6:9) vaydabber moshe ken el bene yisrael velo shamu el moshe mikkotzer ruach. may mikkotzer ruach. amar ribbi yehuda, dela havo nefishe, vela havo lekite rucha. amar ribbi shimon, mikkotzer ruach: dead la nafak yovla, lemehav lon nefishu. veruach batraa, ad la shalta lemebad nimuse, ucheden hava aku derucha. man ihu. ruach batraa dekamran. (nusach acher dead lo yahev leh yovla beracha al hay rucha leitkayyeyma nefesh tattaa velo shalta hay ruach al nefesh ella kad itbarcha miyyovla keden yehe rucha uman ihu ruach)

Ta chaze, ketiv (Shemot 6:12) hen bene yisrael lo shamu elay veech yishmaeni faro vaani aral sefatayim, may vaani aral sefatayim. veha bekadmita ketiv (Shemot 4:10) lo ish devarim anochi vegomer ki chevad pe uchevad lashon anochi, vekudesha berich hu hava otiv leh, (750) mi sam pe laadam vegomer, vehu amar (Shemot 4:12) veanochi ehye im picha, salleka datach dela hava ken, vehashsheta amar vaani aral sefatayim, i hachi, an hu milla deavtach leh kudesha berich hu bekadmita.

Ella raza ihu, moshe kala, vedibbur deihu milla dileh, hava begaluta, vahava ihu atim lefarsha millin, uvegin da amar, veech yishmaeni faro, beod demilla dili ihi begaluta dilleh, deha let li milla. ha ana kala milla gara, deihi begaluta, veal da, shattaf kudesha berich hu leaharon bahadeh.

Ta chaze, kol zimna dedibbur hava begaluta, kala istelak minneh, umilla hava atim belo kol, kad ata moshe, ata kol. umoshe hava kol belo milla, begin dehava begaluta, vechol zimna dedibbur hava begaluta, moshe azil kala bela dibbur, vehachi azil ad dekarivu letura desinay, veityehivat orayyta, uvehahu zimna, itchabbar kala bedibbur, ucheden milla mallil, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 20:1) vaydabber elohim et kol haddevarim haelle. ucheden, moshe ishtechach shelim bemilla kedka yeot, kol vedibbur kachada bishlimu.

Veal da moshe itreim, demilla gara minneh, bar hahu zimna demallilat leitraama aloy, bezimna dichtiv, (Shemot 6) umeaz bati el paro ledabber bishmecha, miyyad (Shemot 6:2) vaydabber elohim el moshe. ta chaze dehachi hu deshara milla lemallela ufasak lah, begin dead la mata zimna dichtiv vaydabber elohim vegomer. ufasak veashlim kala, hada hu dichtiv vayyomer elav ani Adonai. begin dedibbur hava begaluta, vela mata zimna lemallela. (veta chaze)

Begine kach, moshe la hava shelim milla bekadmita, (dehachi itchaze) deihu kol, veate begin dibbur, leappaka leh min galuta. kevan denafak min galuta, veitchabbaru kol vedibbur kachada betura desinay, ishtelim moshe veitse, veishtechach keden kol vedibbur kachada bishlimu.

Ta chaze, kol yomin dehava moshe bemitzrayim, devaa leappaka milla min galuta, la mallil milla, deihu dibbur. kevan denafak min galuta, veitchabbar kol bedibbur, hahu milla deihu dibbur, anhig vedabbar lon leyisrael, aval la mallil, ad dekarivu letura desinay, ufatach beorayyta, dehachi itchaze. vei tema, (Shemot 13:17) ki amar elokim pen yinnachem haam, la ketiv ki dibber, ella ki amar, deihu reuta delibba bachashay, veha (vaychi 234 amud bet) okimna.
549: Vaydabber elohim el moshe vayyomer elav ani Adonai. Rabbi yehuda patach, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:6) kamti ani liftoach ledodi vedodi chamak avar vegomer. kamti ani liftoach ledodi, da kala. ta chaze, keneset yisrael kad ihi begaluta, kalla istelak minah, umilla ishtechach minah, kema deat amar (Tehillim 39:3) neelamtay dumiyya. vei ittear milleta, ma ketiv, vedodi chamak avar, deha kala istelak minah, ufaska milla. (kema deat amar) veal da vaydabber elohim el moshe, shariat lemallela, ufasak veshatik. levatar ashlim kala veamar vayyomer elav ani Adonai.

Vaera el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov, beyaakov tosefet vav, deihu shelimu daavahan, kema deat amar, elohe avraham elohe yitzchak velohe yaakov, beyaakov tosefet vav. amar ribbi yose, i hachi, ha ketiv (Bereshit 28:13) ani Adonai elohe avraham avicha vilohe yitzchak, ha beyitzchak tosefet vav.

Amar leh, shappir hava, begin deyaakov hava kayyaym, veachlil leh leyaakov beyitzchak, (dehava mit) deitchashshechu enoy, vahava kammet, deha beod debar nash ihu kayyaym behay alma, la idkar aloy shema kaddisha, veal da achlil leh beyitzchak. hasheta demit yaakov, ata milla beatreh. hada hu dichtiv vaera el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov, betosefet 6.

Beel shadday (Bereshit 183 amud alef): itchazena lehu, miggo aspakalarya dela nahara. vela itchazena miggo aspakalarya denahara. vei tema deha ishtammeshu benukeva bilchod vela yattir. ta chaze, dela itparshan lealmin, hada hu dichtiv vegam hakimoti et beriti ittam, deha berit itchabbar immah.

Mikudesha berich hu it leh levar nash lemelaf, deha ihu kaamar dela parish lon, dichtiv beel shadday, uchetiv vegam hakimoti et beriti ittam, begin lekayyeyma kiyyuma beyichuda chad, vegam hakimoti et beriti ittam vegomer. ha ittemar, man dezakke livrit, yarit leara.

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yosi, havo shechiche yoma chad kameh deribbi shimon, patach ribbi shimon veamar, (Iyov 19:29) guru (Vayikra 52 amud bet) lachem mippene cherev ki chema avonot cherev lemaan tedun shaddun. shaddin ketiv. guru lachem mippeni cherev, man cherev. da (Vayikra 26:25) cherev nokemet nekam berit, deha hay cherev kaim leistakkela man dimshakker bivrit, dechol man dimshakker bivrit, nukema (vaychi 203 amud bet) denakmin minneh, hay cherev hu.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 19:29) ki chema avonot charev. may taama. begin deman dimshakker bivrit, parish tiuveta, vela natil man denatil, vela yahiv leatreh, deha la ittear legabbeh atreh. vechol man denatir leh lehay berit, ihu garim leitteara lehay berit leatreh. veitbarchan illain vetattain.

Man ittear hay berit leatreh. kad ishtechachu zakkain bealma. mena lan, mehacha, dichtiv, (Shemot 6:4) vegam hakimoti et beriti ittam latet lahem et eretz kenaan et eretz megurehem. may megurehem. kema deat amer guru lachem mippene cherev. begin deihu atar, deashde magor bealma, veal da guru lachem mippene cherev.

Asher garu vah, miyyoma deitkerivu legabbe kudesha berich hu, dechilu bah dechilu, udechilu (nusach acher udechilu dechilu) illaa bah lemitar pikudoy. dei behay la yishde (nusach acher deha lo ashde) dechilu al resheh devar nash, la dachil leh lekudesha berich hu lealmin bishar pikudoy.

Ta chaze, beitaruta diltatta, kad ittearu yisrael legabbe kudesha berich hu, vetzavvchu lokovleh, ma ketiv, vaezkor et beriti, deha bivrit have zachor. ucheden ittear tiuveta, leitkashshera kolla bekishshura chad. kevan dehay berit ittear, ha kishshura decholla ittear. vaezkor et beriti, leizdavvevga leh beatreh. veal da, lachen emor livne yisrael ani Adonai.
(Shemot 6:13) vaydabber Adonai el moshe veel aharon vaytzavvem el beni yisrael veel paro melech mitzrayim. Rabbi yose amar, el bene yisrael ledabbera lon benachat kadka chaze,
550: Veel paro: leanhaga beh yekar, veukemuha.

Amar ribbi yesa, amay samich hacha (Shemot 6:14) elle rashe vet avotam. ella, amar leh kudesha berich hu, dabberu lon livne yisrael benachat, deaf al gav deinnun yatve befulechana kashya, malchin beni malchin innun. uvegin kach, ketiv, elle rashe vet avotam illen deat chame, reshe bet avahan innun.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, dechullehu la shakkeru nimusehon, vela itarvu beamma achara illen innun dekayymu beduchetayyhu kaddisha, vela shakru leitarva behu bemitzrae. amar ribbi acha, begin leayytaa lemoshe uleaharon, deinnun itchazun leappaka lehu leyisrael, ulemallela lefaro, uleraddaa leh bechutera, begin divchol reshehon deyisrael, la ishtechach kevavtayyhu.

Ta chaze, (Shemot 6:25) veelazar ben aharon lakach lo mibbenot putiel lo leishsha vatteled lo et pinchas elle rashe avot haleviyyim. vechi elle rashe, veha hu bilchodoy hava. ella, begin definchas kiyyem kamma alfin verivvavn miyyisrael, vehu kiyyem lerashe avahan, (levae) ketiv beh elle.

Tu, vatteled lo et pinchas elle rashe, ovda dereshe delevae ishtechach beh, uma deinnun (Vayikra 56 amud bet) garu veittukadu, hu ashlim, veravavch kehunata dilhon, vesharya beh tastuka detarvavyyhu. ovda dereshe delevae ishtechach beh, uman ninhu. nadav vaavihu. innun perishu at kayyeyma meatreh, vehu ata vechavar lon. begin kach, ityeyhiv leh yaruta, verucha detarvavyyhu. veadkar hacha al ma delehve levatar.

Vei tema, amay adkar hacha pinchas. ella chama kudesha berich hu leaharon, beshaata deamar vaezkor et beriti, dizminin teren benohi deaharon leafgama leh lehay berit, vehasheta deka meshadder leh lemitzrayim, baa leabera leh leaharon, dela lemehach bishlichuta da. kevan dechama kudesha berich hu, dekaim pinchas vekiyyem leh lehay berit beatreh, veatkin akima dilhon, miyyad hu aharon umoshe. amar kudesha berich hu, hasheta hu aharon, ihu aharon dekadmeta.

(Shemot 6:26) hu aharon umoshe asher amar Adonai lahem hotziu et bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim vegomer. hu aharon umoshe. hem aharon umoshe mibbae leh. ella, leachlala da beda, rucha bemayya. hu moshe veaharon: leachlala mayya berucha, veal da ketiv hu, velo hem.

Ribbi elazar veribbi abba, havo shechiche lelya chad beve oshpizayyhu belud, kamu leishtaddela beorayyta. patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Devarim 4:39) veyadata hayyom vehashevota el levavecha ki Adonai hu haelohim. hay kera hachi mibbae leh. veyadata hayyom ki Adonai hu haelohim vehashevota el levavecha. (ella zakkaa hu man deishtaddal beorayyta) tu, (401 chaze) vehashevota el libbecha mibbae leh.

Ella, amar moshe, i at bae lemekam al da, uleminda ki Adonai hu haelohim, vehashevota el levavecha ucheden tinda leh. levavecha: yetzer tov veyetzer ra, deitkelil da beda, veihu chad, keden tishkach ki Adonai hu haelohim, deha itkelil da beda, veihu chad. veal da vehashevota el levavecha, leminda milla.

Tu amar ribbi elazar, chayyayvin, avdin pegimuta leella, may pegimuta. dismala la itkelil bimina. deyetzer ra la itkelil beyetzer tov, begin chovayyhu divne nasha. ufegimu la avde, ella lon mammash, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 32:5) shichet lo lo banav mumam. kivyachol avde vela avde. avde: dela yitmashshech alayyhu birkan dilella, kema deat amar (Devarim 11:17) veatzar et hashshamayim velo yihye matar. vela avde: deha shemayya natle lon legarmayyhu birkan may deitzterich. vela natle leamshacha letatta vadday mumam deinnun chayyayvin ihu.

Tu, lo bev, dela itkelil yemina bismala, begin dela yitmashshechun birkan letatta. lo beAlef, deha la natle leitmashshecha letattae. man garim da. begin dechayyayvin mafrishin yetzer ra miyyetzer tov, umitdabbekin beyetzer ra.
551: Missitra dismala, veitdevak bimina, begin lenatztzecha amin, (vaychi 243 amud alef) uletavra chelehon. dei la itdevak bimina, la yitbar chelehon. vei tema amay bimina. veha semala itar dinin bealma.

Ella raza da, beshaata dekudesha berich hu dan lehu leyisrael, la dan lehu ella missitra dismala, begin diyhe dache lon bismala, umekarev bimina. aval lishar ammin, dache lon bimina, umekarev lon bismala. vesimanich (338 lecha 188 amud alef) ger tzedek, dache lon bimina, kema dichtiv, (Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev. mekarev lon bismala kema deamaran.

Begine kach, yehuda deihu mistar semala, itdabbak bimina, umetalnoy limina. veinnun deimmeh itchabberu kullehu limina. yissschar delae beorayyta, deihi yemina, dichtiv, (Devarim 33) mimino esh dat lamo. zevulun deihu tamich orayyta yemina, (174 amud bet vayyishlach 172) kema deat amer shok hayyamin. veal da yehuda itkeshar missitra da veda. tzafon bammayim, semala bimina.

Reuven dechata legabbe avoy, (pikkude 223 amud alef) shara bimina, veitkashshar bismala, veitdabbak beh. veal da, innun deishtechachu immeh, innun semala. shimon deihu semala missitra deshor, dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:10) ufene shor mehassemol. gad shoka semala, ketiv (Bereshit 49:19) gad gedud yegudennu vehu yagud akev. hacha, itdabbak darom beeshsha, yemina bismala.

Veal da ha deamaran vehashevota el levavecha, (teruma 162 amud bet) leachlela lon kachada, semala bimina. keden teda (Devarim 4:35) ki Adonai hu haelohim. amar ribbi abba vadday hachi hu, vehasheta yedia, hu aharon umoshe, hu moshe veaharon, rucha bemayya, umayya berucha, lemeheve chad. veal da ketiv hu.

Rabbi abba patach veamar, (dabeham 6) veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha uvechol meodecha. kehay gavvna hacha itremiz yichuda kaddisha, veazhara hu levar nash, leyachada shema kaddisha kedka yeot, birchimu illaa. bechol levavcha: da yemina usemala (nusach acher kaddisha) deikre yetzer tov veyetzer ra. uvechol nafshecha: da nefesh david, deityehivat benayyhu. uvechol meodecha leachlela lon leella baatar delet beh shiura. hacha hu yichuda shelim lemircham leh lekudesha berich hu kedka yeot.
Tu, uvechol meodecha: da yaakov, deihu achid lechol sitrin, vecholla hu yichuda shelim kedka yeot, begine kach, hu aharon umoshe hu moshe veaharon, kolla hu chad bela piruda.

(Shemot 7:9) ki yedabber alechem paro lemor. ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 119:97) ma ahavti toratecha kol hayyom hi sichati. uchetiv, (Tehillim 119:62) chatzot layla akum lehodot lach al mishpete tzidkecha. ta chaze, david ihu malka deyisrael, veitzterich lemedan amma, ledabbera lon leyisrael, keraya dimadbar aneh dela yistun meorcha dikshot. ha ballayla ketiv, chatzot layla akum lehodot lach al mishpete tzidkecha. veihu itasak beorayyta uvetushebchan dekudesha berich hu, ad deate tzafra.

Veihu ittear tzafra, kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 57:9) ura chevodi ura hannevel vechinnor aira shachar. kad ate yemama, amar hay kera, ma ahavti toratecha kol hayyom hi sichati. may kol hayyom hi sichati. ella, mikkan olifna, dechol man deyishtedal beorayyta, leashlema dina al bureyeh, keillu kiyyem orayyta kolla. begin kach, kol hayyom hi sichati.

Ta chaze, beyoma ishtaddal beorayyta, leashlema dinin. belelya, ishtaddal beshirin vetushebchan, ad deate yemama. may tama. kol yoma itasak leashlama dinin, begin leachlala semala bimina. belelya, begin leachlela darga delelya bimama.

Veta chaze, (teruma 145 amud alef) beyome dedavid malka, hava mekarev kol innun (Tehillim 104:11) chayto saday, legabbe yamma. kevan deata shelomo, nafak yamma veitmele, veashke lehu. he minnayyhu itshakyayn bekadmita. ha ukemuha. illen tanninayay ravrevin illain, dichtiv behu, (Bereshit 1:22) umilu et hammayim bayyammim
552: Elazar, besitra yemina illaa, nafkin telesar mabbuin illain, naharin amikin, illen sallekin, veillen nachtin, ayiyil kol chad bechavreh. chad appik resheh, veail leh bitren gufin, chad gufa denahara natil miyyamin leella, afrish letatta elef yeorin, nafkin learba sitrin.

Meinnun naharin mabbuin telesar, mitparshan telesar yeorin, alin venatle mayya, arba mea vetishin vetisha yeorin ufalga, missitra da. vearba mea vetishin vetisha yeorin ufalga, missitra da bismala. ishtear palga mikkan, ufalga mikkan, veitavid chad. da ail ben yeorin, veitavid chivya.

Resha: sumaka kevarda. kashkashoy: takkifin kefarzela. gadpoy: gadpin shatan veitparshan lechol innun yeorin. kad salik zanbeh, (nusach acher legabbeh) mache uvatash lishar nunin, let man deyekum kameh.

Pumeh: melahata eshsha. kad natil bechol innun yeorin, mizdazean shear tanninayay, vearkin vealin beyamma. chad leshivin shenin ravitz lesitra da. vechad leshivin shenin ravitz lesitra da. elef yeorin chaser chad itmalyayn minneh. da tannina, ravitz ben innun yeorin.

Kad natil nafik chad pasuta deeshsha biklifin, kullehu kayymin vezapin bezapoy, (nusach acher vazekapeyn beanpoy) mitarvin innun yeorin leen (nusach acher haayin) tichla uchama. vegalgelin natlin learba sitre dealma. zakif zanbeh, mache leella, mache letatta, kolla arkin kameh.

Ad delistar tzafon, kam chad shalhova deeshsha, vecharoza kare, izdakafu savtin itbedaru led zavyayn, ha ittear man deshavve kodla, al anpoy detannina, kema deittemar, (Yechezkel 29:4) venatatti chachim bilchayyecha vegomer. keden kullehu itbadderun. venaktin leh letanina, venakve anpoy bistar iloy, vealin leh lenukeba dithoma rabba, ad deitbar cheleh, keden ahadru leh lenaharoy. (nusach acher lanecharevay)

Chad leshivin shenin avdin leh keden, begin dela yetashtesh atrin dirkiin usemachayyhu. vealayyhu kolla odan, umevarchan veamrin, (Tehillim 95:6) bou nishtachave venichraa nivrecha lifne Adonai osenu.

Tanninayay illain ilen (sefer acher leella) kayymin innun demitbarchan, kema deat amer (Bereshit 1:22) vayvarech otam elohim. illen shaltin al kol shear nunin, dichtiv umilu et hammayim bayyammim. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita.

Tosefta (Shir HaShirim 1:14) eshkol hakkofer dodi li. eshkol: da imma illaa. ma eshkol mitkashshet bechamma alin bechamma zemorot leyisrael deachlin leh, hachi shechinta illaa, mitkashshetet bechamma kishshutin dishmona kelim, mikkamma karbanin, mikkamma mine tachshitin dechappera livnaha, veihi kamat behon kame malka, umiyyad (Bereshit 9:16) ureitiha lizkor berit olam. vihivat (sefer acher lon sheeltin dilhon) lan sheeltin dilah, beillen birkan detakinu rabbanan bitzlota, lemishal kame malka.

Behahu zimna, kol dinin dishchinta tattaa, deihi 26 adonay, mithappechan lerachame, kegavvna da Adonai, lekayyem (Yeshayahu 1:18) im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu, Adonai. im yadimu chattola. 24. katztzemer yihyu, Adonai. kol dinin (nusach acher kol dinin 9) mitlabbenin mishchinta illaa.

Veihi shechinta 24, (Bereshit 3:24) lahat hacherev hammithappechet lishmor et derech etz hachayyim. veukemuha rabbanan, dimhappecha zimnin rachame, zimnin dina peamim anashim, peamim nashim. zimnin dina, kegavvna da 24. zimnin rachame, kegavvna da Adonai. deha ihu missitra deilana dechayye, kol dinin mithappechin lerachame. umissitra deetz haddaat tov vara, kol rachame mithappechan ledina, lemedan behu leinun deavre al pitgame orayyta.

Veetz da bealma deate, deihu bina, kol shemahan dedina mithappechin bah (ledina) rachame, begin da ukemuha rabbanan, lo kehaolam hazze haolam habba. uvegin da, bina, ihi lahat hacherev hammithappechet, demithappechet middina lerachame latzaddikim, lemehav lon agra bealma deate. malchut, lahat hacherev hammithappechet, merachame ledina, lemedan bah lerashiayyay
553: Aval meetz haddaat tov vara, deihu kegavvna dematte, zimnin demithappechin hannashim leshedot, anashim leshedim. uvegin da, (Bereshit 29:12) vayyagged yaakov lerachel. uvegin da, ukemuha rabbanan, delet leh levar nash leshammesha im itteteh, ad dimsapper immah, shemma nitchallefa lo besheda. begin delahat beetz haddaat tov vara, mithappechet mittov lara, vei tema dimchashshefe paro, dichtiv vayyaasu chen hachartummim belatehem. havo mehappechin innun matot dilhon linchashin. umissitra deillen hippuchan yachlin leithappecha. (ad kan tosefta).

(Shemot 7:9) veamarta el aharon kach et mattecha. may taama matte aharon, velo matte moshe. ella, hahu demoshe ihu kaddisha yattir, deitgelif beginta illaa bishma kaddisha, vela bae kudesha berich hu lesoova leh beinnun chuterin decharshayya. velo od, ella leachpeyay lon lechol innun deatyayn missitra dismala, begin deaharon ata mimina, usemala itkafyay bimina.

Ribbi chiyyay shail leribbi yose, ha galle kame kudesha berich hu, deinnun charashin yaavdun tanninayay, may gevureta ihu lemebad kame paro tanninayay. amar leh, begin demittamman hu sheruta lealkaa, umishsheruta detannina shaari shuletaneh, (nusach acher lashevalenayh umishsheruta dashevaletaneyh sare lealkaa) keden, chadu kullehu charashe, deha resh chachmeta denachash dilhon hachi hava. miyyad ithaddar hahu tannina deaharon leaa yevesha, uvala lon.

Veal da tavvhu, veyadu deshuletana illaa it beara, deinnun chashivu, deha letatta, (nusach acher leella) bar minnayyhu la it shultana lemebad midi, keden, vayyivla matte aharon, matte aharon dayyka, deithaddar leaa uvala lon.

Veal da aved aharon teren atin, chad leella, vechad letatta. chad leella, tannina illaa deshalta al innun dilhon. chad letatta, deshalit aa al tannina dilhon. ufaro chakkim hava mikkol charashoy, veistakkal deshultana illaa shalit al ara, shalit leella shalit letatta.

Amar ribbi yose, i tema, charashayya kol ma deavdin lav ihu ella bechezu deena, dehachi itchaze, vela yattir, ka mashma lan vayyihyu dayyka, dichtiv vayyihyu letanninim. veamar ribbi yose, afillu innun tanninaya dilhon ahadru lemehve ain, veaa deaharon bala lon.

Ketiv, (Yechezkel 29:3) hinni alecha paro melech mitzrayim hattannim haggadol harovetz betoch yeorav. mittamman sheruta letatta beshuletana dilhon. aval chachmeta dilhon, letatta mikkullehu dargin ihu. (inun)

Ta chaze, chachmeta dilhon bedargin tattain, leachfeyayn lon leillen dargin bedargin illain, reshe shuletanutehon veikara dilhon, letatta mehahu tannina, umishtalshelan betannina, deha mittamman natil chela darga illaa dilhon. mashma dichtiv, (Shemot 11) asher achar harechayim.

Ribbi chiyyay, hava yativ yoma chada, avava detara deusha. chama leh leribbi elazar chad katfira tasa gabbeh, amar leh leribbi elazar, mashma, deafillu beorchach kolla teivin limehach avatrach. ahdar resha vechama leh. amar, vadday shelichuta it gabbeh. deha kudesha berich hu becholla avid shelichuteh, vechama shelichin it leh lekudesha berich hu, dela tema millin deit behu rucha bilchodayyhu, ella afillu innun millin delet behu rucha.

Patach veamar, (Chavakuk 2:11) ki even mikkir tizak vechafis meetz yaanenna. kamma it leh levar nash leizdahara mechovoy, dela yechota kame kudesha berich hu. vei yema man yashid beh. ha avni beteh veae beteh yashidu beh. ulezimnin dekudesha berich hu avid behu shelichuta. ta chaze chutera deaharon, deihu aa yevesha, kudesha berich hu sheruta denissin aved beh, utere shelichute beh itavidu. chad deihu aa yevesha uvala leinun tanninayay dilhon. vechad deha leshaata ithaddar berucha veitavid birya.
554: Ruchehon, deinnun deamrin, dela zamin kudesha berich hu leachayay metayyay, vehech yitavid minnayyhu birya chadta. yetun veyechomun innun tippeshain chayyayvayya, rechikin meorayyta, rechikin minneh, bideh deaharon hava chutera, aa yevesha, vekudesha berich hu lefum shaata ahdar leh birya, meshanya berucha vegufa. innun gufin, dahavo behu ruchin venishmatin kaddishin, venatru pikkude orayyta, veishtaddalu beorayyta yemama velele, vekudesha berich hu tamir lon beafra. levatar, bezimna dichade alma, al achat kamma vechamma deyaavid lehu birya chadta.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, velo od, ella dehahu gufa dehava, yakum. mashma dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) yichyu metecha, vela ketiv yivra, mashma deviryayn innun aval yichyu. deha (Bereshit 137 amud bet) garma chad, yishtear min gufa techot ara, vehahu la itrekav vela itbele beafra lealmin, uvehahu zimna, kudesha berich hu yerakkech leh, veyavid leh kachamira beisa, veyistelak veyitpeshat learba zavyayn uminneh yishtachlal gufa vechol shayyfoy. vekudesha berich hu yahiv beh rucha levatar. amar leh ribbi elazar hachi hu. veta chaze, hahu garma bema itrechach. battal. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) ki tal orot tallecha vegomer.

Vayyomer Adonai el moshe emor el aharon kach mattecha unete yadcha al meme mitzrayim al naharotam al yeorehem veal agmehem veal kol mikve memehem vayyihyu dam vegomer. amar ribbi yehuda, hay kera it leistakkela beh, vehech yachil lemehach lechol hane atre. (velo od ella) vetu, deha ketiv veyyimmale shivat yamim achare hakkot Adonai et hayeor. et hayeor ketiv, veat amart al meme mitzrayim al naharotam al yeorehem veal agmehem.

Ella, meme mitzrayim nilus hava. umittamman itmalyayn kol innun shear agammin viorin umabbuin vechol memin dilhon. veal da, aharon lo nata lemachaa ella lenilus bilchodoy. veta chaze dehachi hu, dichtiv velo yachlu mitzrayim lishtot mayim min hayeor.

Amar ribbi abba, ta chaze, mayin tattain mitparshan lechamma sitrin, (nusach acher umayin illae ad kan vegomer) (illain deha) umayin illain mitkanshe beve kenishu mayya, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:9) vayyomer elohim yikkavu hammayim mittachat hashshamayim el makom echad. uchetiv ulemikkeve hammayim kara yammim. hay kera ukemuha. veta chaze, hahu rekia deit beh shimsha vesihara kochavayay umazzale, da ihu be kenishut mayya rabba, dehu natil kol mayin, veashke leara, dehi alma tattaa, kevan, denatal mayya badar lon, ufalig lon lechol ivar, umittamman itshakyayn kolla.

Uvezimna dedina sharya, alma tattaa la yanka min hahu rekia, veyanka missetar semala, ucheden ikre (Yeshayahu 34:6) cherev laAdonai mala dam. vavy leinun deyankin keden minah, veitshakyayn minah, divhahu zimna yamma yanka mitteren sitrin, hava itpelag litren chulakin, chivvavr vesumak. ucheden shade liora chulaka demitzrayim, vealke leella vealke letatta. veal da shatan yisrael mayya. umitzrae dama.

I tema begin giula hava vela yattir. ta chaze, shatan dama veal lemeayyhu, veistallak uvaka, ad dahavo mezabbenin lon yisrael mayya bemamona, ucheden shatan mayya begini kach sheruta lealkaa lon hava dama.

Ribbi yitzchak patach hay kera, (Tehillim 145:1) aromimcha elohay hammelech vaavarcha shimcha leolam vaed. ta chaze, david lokovel darga deleh kaamar, dichtiv elohay didi. begin devaa lesalleka shevacheh, uleaala leh linhora illaa, leitarva da beda, lemeheve kolla chad. begine kach, aromimcha elohay hammelech vegomer.
Detanenan, kol yomoy dedavid, ishtaddal leatkena kuresya, uleanhara anpaha, begin deyagin aleh veitnehir tadir nehora tattaa
555: Binhora illaa, lemehve kolla chad. vechad ata shelomo, ashkach alma shelim, vesihara deitmalya, vela itzterich leatrecha alla leanhara. (ad kan)

Ta chaze, beshaata devae kudesha berich hu lemesav nukemin meammin ovde avoda zara, ittear semala, veitmalya sihara mehahu sitra dama. ucheden, navin mabbuin unechalin diltatta, kol innun delistar semala dama. veal da, dina dilhon dama.

Ta chaze, kad hay dama ittear (nusach acher kad dina ittear al alma begin hahu dema dekatulin kudesha berich hu ittear) al amma, hahu dama dekatulin ihu deyittear alayyhu amma achara vekatil lon. aval (hasheta) bemitzrayim, la baa kudesha berich hu leayytaa alayyhu amma achara leatara alayyhu dama begin deyisrael havo benayyhu, vela yitztaarun begin dedayyrin beara dilhon, aval kudesha berich hu macha lon bedama, benaharin dilhon, dela havo yachlin lemishte.

Uvegin deshuletanuta dilhon, shalta behahu nahara, pakid kudesha berich hu leshuletanuta dilhon bekadmita, begin deyalke dachala dilhon bekadmita, begin denilus chad dachala dilhon hava, vechen shear dachalin dilhon navin dama. hada hu dichtiv vehaya dam bechol eretz mitzrayim uvaetzim uvaavanim.

Rabbi chiyyay kam lelya chad lemile beorayyta, vahava immeh Rabbi yose zuta, dehava ravya. patach Rabbi chiyyay veamar, (Kohelet 9:7) lech echol besimcha lachmecha ushete velev tov yiyinecha ki chevar ratza haelohim et maasecha. may ka chama shelomo deamar hay kera.

Ella shelomo kol milloy bechachma havo, vehay deamar lech echol besimcha lachmecha, beshaata devar nash azil beorchoy dekudesha berich hu, kudesha berich hu mekarev leh legabbeh, veyahiv leh shalva venayycha, keden nahama vechamra deachil veshate, bechedva delibba, begin dekudesha berich hu itree beovadoy.

Amar leh hahu ravya, i hachi, ha amart dechol milloy deshlomo bechachmeta havo, an hu chachmeta hacha. amar leh beri tevashshel bishshulach, vetecheme hay kera. amar leh ad la bashilna yadana. amar leh mena lan.

Amar leh kala chad shemana meabba, dehava amar behay kera, deshlomo ka azhar leh lebar nash, leattera lah lochneset yisrael besimcha, deihu sitra dimina, veihu nahama, deyitattar bechedva. ulevatar, yitattar bechamra, deihu semala, begin detishtechach bimhemanuta decholla, chedvavta shelemata, bimina usemala, vechad tehve ben tarvavyyhu keden kol birkan sharan bealma. vechol da, kad itree kudesha berich hu beovadehon divne nasha, hada hu dichtiv ki chevar ratza haelohim et maasecha. ata Rabbi chiyyay uneshakeh, amar, chayyecha beri hay milla shavakna beginach, vehasheta yadana, dekudesha berich hu bae leattera lach beorayyta.

Tu patach Rabbi chiyyay veamar, emor el aharon kach mattecha unete yadcha al meme mitzrayim. may tama aharon velo moshe. ella, amar kudesha berich hu, aharon mayin kayymin beducheteh, usemala bae lenagda mayin mittamman, aharon deate mehahu sitra yittear leh, vechad semala nakit lon, innun yithadderun dama.

Ta chaze tattaa dechol dargin macha bekadmita. amar rabbi shimon mittattaa shara kudesha berich hu. veyada dileh, macha bechol etzbea veetzbea. vechad mata ledarga illaa dechol dargin, aved ihu dileh, veavar beara demitzrayim, vekatal kolla. uvegine kach katal kol bucherin beara demitzrayim, begin deihu darga illaa uvuchera decholla.

Veta chaze, paro hava shuletaneh bemayya, (nusach acher bekadmita vametateah shara kudesha berich hu vechad mata ledarga ilaa dilhon deihu buchera dechol dargin dilhon katal kol buchera beara demitzrayim begin hahu darga ilaa uvuchera dechola veta chaze paro hava buchera veshuletaneh bemayya) dichtiv, (Yechezkel 29:3) hattannim haggadol harovetz betoch yeorav, begin kach ithappach nahareh bedama bekadmita. levatar tzefardeim dimshammete lon bekalin tesirin mekarkerin bego meayyhu, (nusach acher mekarkerin bego yeora) venafke miggo yeora, vesalke beyabbeshta veramin kalin bechol sitrin, ad deinnun naflin kemetin bego beta.
Veraza demilla, kol innun eser atin deavad kudesha berich hu, kullehu havo miggo yada takkifa, vehahu yada ittekaf al innun dargin
556: Kullehu shultanuta dilhon, begin levalbela datayyhu, vela havo yade lemebad midi. ta chaze, kol innun dargin dilhon, kevan denafke lemebad midi, deitchaze lecholla la yachlin (levatar) lemebad midi. (emat kad) (nusach acher begin hahu) yada takkifa (sefer acher sharya) desharya alayyhu.

(Dichtiv) (Shemot 7:28) vesharatz hayeor tzefardeim vealu uvau bevetecha. Rabbi shimon patach veamar, (Yirmeyahu 31:15) kol berama nishma nehi bechi tamrurim rachel mevakka al baneha vegomer. ta chaze, hay kera ukemuha bechamma atre. vehay kera kashya, rachel mevakka al banyha, benaha derachel yosef uvinyamin havo vela yattir, velea (kullehu) shit shevatin havo dilah, amay bachat rachel velo lea.

Ella hachi amru ketiv, (Bereshit 29:17) veene lea rakkot. amay rakkot. begin dechol yoma nafkat lefarashat orchin, veshaalat al esav, vahavu amrin lah ovadoy dehahu rasha, vedachilat leminpal bego adveh, vahavat bachat kol yoma, ad deitrekachu enaha.

Vekudesha berich hu amar, ant bachat begin hahu tzaddika, dela teheve beadveh dehahu rasha. chayyayich, achatach takum befarashat orchin, vetivke al galutehon deyisrael, veat takum lego vela tivke alayyhu verachel ihi bachat al galutehon deyisrael.

Aval hay kera, ihu al ma deamaran. aval raza demilla, derachel velea tere almin ninhu. chad alma detekasya, vechad alma deitgalya. veal da, da itkabberat veitchafiat lego bimarta veitkesiat. veda kayyeyma befarashat archin beitgalya. vecholla kegavvna illaa. uvegin kach la ail lah yaakov bimarta, vela baatar achara, deha ketiv (Bereshit 48:7) beod kivrat eretz lavo efrata, vela ail lah lemata. begin dehava yada deatrah hava beatra deitgalya.
Ta chaze, keneset yisrael hachi ikre, rachel. kema deat amer, (yeshaya 52) ucherachel lifni gozzeha neelama. amay neelama. dechad shaltin shear ammin, kala itpesak minah, vehi itallemat.

Veda hu dichtiv, kol berama nishma nehi bechi tamrurim. kol berama nishma da yerushalayim leella. rachel mevakka al baneha, kol zimna deyisrael innun begaluta, ihi mevakka alayyhu deihi imma dilhon. meana lehinnachem al baneha. may tama. ki ennnu. ki enam mibbae leh. ella, begin devalah deihu kol, istallak minah, vela itchabbar bahadah.

Veta chaze, lav shaata chada, ihi devachat alayyhu deyisrael, ella bechol zimna vezimna deinnun begaluta. uvegine kach, kudesha berich hu garam lon kala lemitzrae, dichtiv, (Shemot 11:6) vehayta tzeaka gedola bechol eretz mitzrayim asher kamohu lo nihyata vegomer. vezamin lon kalin acharanin, beinnun uredanin, deraman kalin bemeayyhu, vahavu nafle bashshevake kammetim.

Vattaal hatztzefardea, chada havat, veolidat, veitmalyayt ara minayyhu. vahavu kullehu masrin garmayyhu leeshsha, dichtiv uvetannurecha uvemisharotecha, umay havo amru. (Tehillim 66:12) banu baesh uvammayim vattotzienu larvaya. vei tema i hachi may ichpat lehu lemitzrae dealin leesha kol inun ordeanin ella kulhu alin leesha veazlin betanura vela metin. veinun demettin may ka avde. nahama hava betanura vealin bego nahama umitbakin venafke minayyhu acharanin veishtaarin benahamma. atu lemechal mine hahu pita ithadru ordeanayay bemeayyhu verakdan veramman kalin ad dehavu metim. veda kashyay lon mikkola. ta chaze ketiv vesharatz hayeor tzefardeim vealu uvau bevetecha uvachadar mishkavcha veal mittatcha. paro ihu alke kadmaa mikkulhu veyattir mikkulhu. lehve shemeh di elaha mevorach min alma vead alma dehava pakid ovadin divne nasha vechol ma deavde.
Ketiv (Bereshit 12:15) vayyiru otah sare faro vayhallu otah el paro vattukkach haishsha bet paro. hay kera lidderasha hu deata. telat faro
557: Hacha. chad, behahu zimna. vechad, beyomoy deyosef. vechad, beyomoy demoshe dealke bekolfoy. (sefer acher hay kera kolla itkeyyaym befaro kadmaa aval beshaata vechulei vehay kera itkeyyaym)

Paro kadmaa, beshaata deitnesivat sara legabbeh, ramaz leumanin, vetziyyeyru hahu diyyukena beiddareh, al arseh bechotala, la nach dateh, ad deavdu diyyukena desara binsiru, vechad salik learseh, salik lah immeh. kol malka deata avatreh, hava chame hahu diyyukena metzayyeyra tziyyura, vahavu alin kameh bedichin, kad salik learseh hava ithane behahu tziyyur. begin kach, malka alke hacha yattir mikkolla. (401 chaze) hayeynu dichtiv, uvachadar mishkavcha veal mittatecha. ulevatar, uvevet avadecha uveammecha. uvechullehu la ketiv al mittatam, ella leh bilchodeh.

Rabbi abba patach, (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam vehayyam enennu male el makom shehannechalim holchim sham hem shavim lalachet. hay kera ittemar, veamre leh chavrayyay. aval ta chaze, kad innun nachalin alin lego yamma, veyamma nakit lon, veshaiv lon begavveh, begin dekafan mayya bego yamma, vehahu gelidi shaiv kol mayya dealin beh, ulevatar nafkin mayya betukefa dedarom, veashke yat kol chevat bara, kema deat amer (Tehillim 104:11) yashku kol chayto saday.
(Zehu hannizkar hacha) veta chaze, yamma dekafa shaiv kol mayya, veishtere betukefa dedarom, kema deittemar, uvegin kach enennu male, veittemar.

Veha ittearu beh chavrayyay. el makom shehannechalim holchim sham hem shavim lalachet. may taama hem shavim. begin dehahu nahar denagid venafik meeden la pasik lealmin, vehu appik tadir mayya leyamma, veal da, mayin shavin lalechet, vetavin, veazlin vetavin, vela paskin lealmin. vechad ihu tav lalechet, begin lemehach leashkaa lecholla, veate ruach (vaere 24 amud alef) tzafon vekafe mayya, verucha dedarom deihu chamima, (sefer acher sare) shadde lon lemehach lechol setar. veal da, hay yamma yativ ben tere sitre illen, uveginayyhu kayyeyma, vearvin azlin venatlin lechol setar.

Ta chaze, kad malka, ate learseh, beshaata deitpelig lelya, rucha detzafon ittear, deihu ittear chavivuta legabbe matronita, deilmale itaruta detzafon, la itchabbar malka bahadah, begin detzafon share chavivuta, kema deittemar, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi. vedarom chavik birchimu dichtiv vimino techabbekeni, keden kamma bedichin mitarin shirata, ad deate tzafra, dichtiv, (Iyov 38:7) beran yachad kochve boker vayyariu kol bene elohim.
Vechad ate tzafra, kullehu illae vetattae amre shirata, veyisrael kegavvna da letatta, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 62:6-7) hammazkirim et Adonai al domi lachem. al domi lachem letatta dayyka. (ballayla)

Kad itpelig lelya, innun detiuveta dilhon leadkera tadir lekudesha berich hu, la yahave shechivu lelibba, vekayymin leadkera leh lekudesha berich hu. kad salik tzafra makdimin leve kenishta, umeshabbechan leh lekudesha berich hu. vechen batar palgut yoma. vechen belelya, kad itchashach veitdevak lelya bechashocha, uvat shimsha. al illen ketiv hammazkirim et Adonai al domi lachem. veda amma kaddisha deyisrael.

Veal da, adkar lon kudesha berich hu bemitzrayim, vesalik al paro, illen dela mishtachche yemama velelya, uman innun. uredanya, dekalehon la mishtechach tadir, begin deatkif beamma kaddisha, dela mishtachche yemama velele, leshabbecha leh lekudesha berich hu. vela hava bar nash bemitzrayim, deyachil lemishtae bahade hadade. uminnayyhu itchabbelat ara. umikkallehon havo yenokin veravyayn metin.
Vei tema hech la yachlin lekatla lon. ella, i arim bar nash chutera, o avana, lekatla chada, itvakat, venafkin shit minah, miggo meaha, veazle vetartashe beara, ad dehavi, mitmana lemikrav behu.
Ta chaze, kamma naharin, kamma yeorin, nafka miggo yamma illaa, kad itmashshechan umishteran mayya, (vaychi 243) umitpalgin
558: Kamma nechalin, lechamma sitrin, lechamma yeorin, lechamma naharin. vechulaka dimmana desitra demitzrayim innun mayin (Bereshit 129) merachashan illen, delet lach mayin denafkin miggo yamma, dela mafke nunin lezinin.

Man innun nunin. innun shelichan bealma, memanan lemebad reuta demarehon, memanan berucha dechachmeta. veal da tanenan, it mayin megaddelin chakkimin. veit mayin megaddelin tippeshin. lefum innun naharin demitchallekin lechol sitrin.

Vehacha nahare demitzrae, megaddelin mare decharashin, nunin besitin, kefitin beeser dargin decharashin, dichtiv, (Devarim 18:10-11) kosem, kesamim, meonen, umenachesh, umechashshef, vechover chaver, veshoel ov, veyiddeoni, vedoresh el hammetim. ha eser zinin dechachmeta decharashayya.

Uvehahu zimna, oshit kudesha berich hu etzbea dideh, uvalbel innun nechalin naharin demitzrae, veitmenau innun nune dechachmeta dilhon. chad ithappach ledama, vechad desaliku nune kalin, (dechullehu nunin talyayn) belo toalta, vela ate alayyhu rucha deinnun chachmetan.

Arov: ki hay gavvna, deirbev lon zine dechachmeta dilhon, vela yachlin leitdabbeka, velo od, ella afillu dehane deishtechachu beara, mechabbelan lon beara, umechabbelan orchayyhu. arov, may arov. irbuveya. kema deat amer (Vayikra 19:19) uveged kilayim. iruvin: (Vayikra 19:19) sadcha lo tizra kilayim: zinin saggiin bearamut yeda.

Ta chaze, kamma chelin itaru leella kechad, uvalbel lon kudesha berich hu kachada, begin levalbela cheylayyhu takkifa leella. vechol innun gevuran deavad kudesha berich hu bemitzrayim, bida chada hava, dearim yedeh alayyhu, leella vetatta, umittamman itavidat chachmeta demitzrayim, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 29:14) veavda chachmat chachamav uvinat nevonav tistattar.

Veta chaze, ketiv, (Yeshayahu 19:2) vesichsachti mitzrayim bemitzrayim. mitzrayim leella, bemitzrayim letatta. begin deinnun chelin leella, memanan al chelin diltatta, veitarvu kullehu. itarvu leella, dela havo mitzrae yachle leitkashshera becharashayyhu, beinnun duchete dahavo mitkashshere bekadmita, deha itbalbalu. veal da ayyte alayyhu arov, chivavn dahavo mitarve da beda.
Kinnim, desalleka afra deara. veta chaze, kol iva deityelidat beara, mechela dilella memana deizdera ala ihu, vecholla hava kegavvna dilella.

Veta chaze, shiva rekiin aved kudesha berich hu, kegavvna da shiva aran. veinnun techumin demitparshan beduchetayyhu. 7 rekiin leella, shiva techume ara leella, kehay gavvna letatta mitparshan dargin, 7 rekiin, vez techume ara. veha ukemuhu chavrayyay, bez arin kesufeta da al da.

Veinnun 7 techume ara leella, kol chad vechad (mitparshan leshivin memanan) mitparshan leeser, veinnun mitpallegan le memanan, dimmanan al shivin ammin. (balak 209 amud bet) vehahu ara, techuma dechol amma veamma, sachara leara kaddisha deyisrael. kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 3:7) hinni mittato shellishlomo shishshim gibborim saviv lah miggibbore yisrael vaasara begavavyyhu temirin, veinnun 70 desacharan ara kaddisha. veda hu leella, kegavvna da letatta.

Veta chaze, hahu ara, techuma dechulaka demitzrae, behahu zimna, oshit kudesha berich hu etzbea dileh, veityelidu tafsirin behahu techuma, veityevashu kol innun techumin derakkichu mayya. vechol yeroka demayin denavin, keden letatta, itchaziu kilmin meafra deara.

Veha ittemar deaharon hava mache. aval begin da aharon hava mache, leachazaa dimina dekudesha berich hu tavar lesanin, kema deat amer, (Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev. kegavvna da, zamin kudesha berich hu leayytaa al karta deromi rabbeta, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 34:9) venehefchu nechaleha lezefet vaafarah legafrit. veal da, kol afar haaretz haya chinnim bechol eretz mitzrayim.
Ribbi yehuda veribbi chiyyay, havo azle beorcha. amar ribbi chiyyay, chavrayyay kad innun beorcha,
559: Bayayn lemehach belibba chad. vei iarau, o azle begavavyyhu chayyayve alma, o bene nasha delav innun mehechala demalka, bau leitparsha minnayyhu. mena lan. mikkalev, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 14:24) veavdi chalev ekev hayta ruach acheret immo vaymalle acharay. may ruach acheret. deitperash meinun meallelin, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 14:24) vayyaalu vannegev vayyavo ad chevron. deitperash meinun meallelin veata ihu bilchodoy lechevron, leishtattecha al kivre avahan.

Vechevron, ityehiv leh chulak achasana leittatkefa beh, kema deat amer, (Devarim 1:36) velo etten et haaretz asher darach bah. amay yahivu leh chevron. i begin deishtattach bekivre avahan leishtezava mehahu eta dilhon deishteziv. la.

Ella, raza demilla shemana. kegavvna da ketiv, (Shmuel 2 2:1) vayyishal david baAdonai lemor haeele beachat are yehuda vayyomer Adonai elav ale vayyomer david anna eele vayyomer chevrona. hacha it leistakkela, kevan deha mit shaul, vedavid beyome deshaul itmeshach lekabbela malchu. kevan demit shaul amay la amlichu leh ledavid, vela kabbil malchu al kol yisrael, veata lechevron, vmalchu kabbil al yehuda bilchodoy sheva shanim, veitakkav tamman kol hane sheva shanim. ulevatar demit ish boshet, kabbil malchu al kol yisrael birushalayim.

Ella, kolla hu raza kame kudesha berich hu. ta chaze, malchuta kaddisha la kabbil malchu shelemata, ad deitchabbar (Bereshit 79 amud bet) baavahan. vechad itchabbar behu, itbeni bevinyayna shelimu, mealma illaa, vealma (Bereshit 247 amud alef) illaa ikre sheva shanim, begin dechullehu beh.

Vesimanicha (Melachim 1 6:38) vayyivnehu sheva shanim, da alma illaa. vela ketiv vayyivnehu besheva shanim. kema deat amer, (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. man sheshet yamim, da avraham. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, beavraham. veavraham sheshet yamim ikre. uvegin (nusach acher uveh) deihu sheshet yamim, itbene alma. behahu (nusach acher behay) gavvna vayyivnehu sheva shanim.

Veta chaze, david baa leitbenaa bemalchu shelemata letatta, kegavvna dilella, vela itbene, ad deata veitchabbar baavahan. vekaim sheva shanim leitbenaa begavavyyhu. levatar sheva shanim, itbene becholla, itmashshecha malchuteh di la tade lealmin. vei lav deitavad bechevron leitchabbera beducheteh, la itbeni malchuteh leitmashcha kedka yeot. kehay gavvna kalev, itnehir beh rucha dechachmeta, veata lechevron, leitchabbera baavahan, uleducheteh azil, ulevatar, ducheteh hava, veyarit leh.

Ribbi yesa (nidpas mikketz 196 amud bet) veribbi chizkiyya, havo azle mikkapputekiyya lelud, vahava immehon chad yuday bematul dekatfira dachamara. ad dahavo azle, amar ribbi yesa leribbi chizkiyya, aftach pumach, veema chad milla, meinun mille mealleyayta deorayyta, deat amart bechol yoma, kame butzina kaddisha.

Patach veamar, (Mishlei 3:17) deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom. deracheha darche noam, illen orchin deorayyta, deman deazil beorche deorayyta, kudesha berich hu, ashre aleh neimuta dishchinta, dela tade mineh lealmin. vechol netivoteha shalom, dechol shevilin deorayyta, kulehon shelam. shelam leh leella, shelam leh letatta. shelam leh bealma den, shelam leh bealma deate.
Amar hahu yuday, isura bekistera, behay kera ishtechach. amar leh mennayin lach. amar leh, meabba shemana, veolifna hacha behay kera milla tava.
Patach veamar, hay kera bitren gavvnin ihi, uvitren sitrin. kare beh derachim, vekare beh netivot. kare beh noam, vekare beh shalom. man derachim. uman netivot. man noam. uman shalom.

Ella, deracheha darche noam, hayeynu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 43:16) hannoten bayyam darech. deha kol atar deikre beorayyta derech, hu orcha peticha lecholla. kehay orcha dehu patiach lechol bar nash. kach deracheha, illen derachim deinnun petichan meavahan, decharan beyamma
